source.text: וַיִּשְׁלַ֖ח הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ וַיַּאַסְפ֣וּ אֵלָ֔יו כָּל־זִקְנֵ֥י יְהוּדָ֖ה וִירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And sent the king, and they gathered to him all [the] elders of Judah and Jerusalem.

en.L: And the king sent, and they gathered to him all the elders of Judah and Jerusalem.
en.B: Then the king sent word, and all the elders of Judah and Jerusalem were gathered to him.
en.R: Then King Josiah sent for all the elders of Judah and Jerusalem, and they came together to meet with him.

es.L: Y el rey envió, y se reunieron con él todos los ancianos de Judá y de Jerusalén.
es.B: Entonces el rey mandó llamar, y todos los ancianos de Judá y de Jerusalén se reunieron con él.
es.R: Entonces el rey Josías mandó llamar a todos los ancianos de Judá y de Jerusalén, y ellos se reunieron con él.

fr.L: Et le roi envoya [des messagers], et on rassembla auprès de lui tous les anciens de Juda et de Jérusalem.
fr.B: Alors le roi fit convoquer tous les anciens de Juda et de Jérusalem, qui se rassemblèrent auprès de lui.
fr.R: Ensuite le roi Josias a fait appeler tous les anciens de Juda et de Jérusalem, et ils se sont réunis auprès de lui.

sw.L: Naye mfalme akatuma, nao wakamkusanyikia wazee wote wa Yuda na Yerusalemu.
sw.B: Kisha mfalme alituma ujumbe, na wazee wote wa Yuda na Yerusalemu wakakusanyika kwake.
sw.R: Kisha mfalme Yosia aliwaita wazee wote wa Yuda na Yerusalemu, nao wakakusanyika kukutana naye.

vi.L: Vua sai [người], và họ nhóm lại đến cùng vua tất cả các trưởng lão Giu-đa và Giê-ru-sa-lem.
vi.B: Bấy giờ vua sai người đi, và tất cả các trưởng lão Giu-đa và Giê-ru-sa-lem được triệu tập đến gặp vua.
vi.R: Rồi vua Giô-si-a cho mời tất cả các trưởng lão Giu-đa và Giê-ru-sa-lem, và họ nhóm lại họp với vua.

ko.L: 그리고 왕이 [사람을] 보내자, 유다와 예루살렘의 모든 장로가 그에게 모였다.
ko.B: 그러자 왕이 사람을 보내어, 유다와 예루살렘의 모든 장로를 자기에게로 불러 모았다.
ko.R: 그러자 요시야 왕은 유다와 예루살렘의 모든 장로를 불렀다. 그들이 왕을 만나려고 함께 모였다.

pt.L: E o rei enviou [mensageiros], e reuniram junto dele todos os anciãos de Judá e de Jerusalém.
pt.B: Então o rei mandou chamar todos os anciãos de Judá e de Jerusalém, e eles se reuniram junto dele.
pt.R: Então o rei Josias mandou chamar todos os anciãos de Judá e de Jerusalém, e eles vieram se reunir com ele.

decisions.choice: the king: Josiah, acting on the word Huldah gave him
decisions.reason: The chapter goes straight on from chapter 22. The book found in the temple had been read to Josiah, and the prophet Huldah had said that the disaster it threatened would come, but not in his days, because he had humbled himself (22:8-20). His first act is to call the leaders of the nation together.

decisions.choice: the elders: the heads of families and towns
decisions.reason: The elders were the senior men who led the clans and towns and spoke for the people (1 Kings 8:1; 20:7). The king calls them before he calls the whole nation (verse 2).

decisions.choice: they gathered to him: the elders came at his summons
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says only that the king "sent" and that "they gathered". He sent messengers, and the elders were brought together before him.

decisions.choice: King Josiah sent for ... they came together to meet with him
decisions.reason: Readable names the king and says what "sent" means here: he summoned the elders.

source.text: וַיַּ֣עַל הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ בֵּית־יְהוָ֡ה וְכָל־אִ֣ישׁ יְהוּדָה֩ וְכָל־יֹשְׁבֵ֨י יְרוּשָׁלִַ֜ם אִתּ֗וֹ וְהַכֹּֽהֲנִים֙ וְהַנְּבִיאִ֔ים וְכָל־הָעָ֖ם לְמִקָּטֹ֣ן וְעַד־גָּד֑וֹל וַיִּקְרָ֣א בְאָזְנֵיהֶ֗ם אֶת־כָּל־דִּבְרֵי֙ סֵ֣פֶר הַבְּרִ֔ית הַנִּמְצָ֖א בְּבֵ֥ית יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And went up the king [to the] house of Yahweh, and every man of Judah and all [the] inhabitants of Jerusalem with him, and the priests and the prophets and all the people, from small and to great; and he read in their ears all [the] words of [the] book of the covenant which was found in [the] house of Yahweh.

en.L: And the king went up [to the] house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and every man of Judah and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem with him, and the priests and the prophets and all the people, from small to great; and he read in their ears all the words of the book of the covenant that had been found in the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: The king went up to the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and with him went {{gender:all the people of Judah|all the men of Judah}} and all who lived in Jerusalem, the priests and the prophets, and all the people, from the least to the greatest. In their hearing he read out all the words of the book of the covenant, which had been found in the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: The king went up to the temple of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. {{gender:All the people of Judah|All the men of Judah}} and everyone who lived in Jerusalem went with him. The priests and the prophets went too, and all the people, from the least important to the most important. The king read aloud to them everything written in the book of the covenant that had been found in {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s temple.

es.L: Y subió el rey [a la] casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, y con él todo hombre de Judá y todos los habitantes de Jerusalén, y los sacerdotes y los profetas y todo el pueblo, desde el más pequeño hasta el más grande; y leyó a sus oídos todas las palabras del libro del pacto que había sido hallado en la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.B: El rey subió a la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, y con él fueron {{gender:toda la gente de Judá|todos los hombres de Judá}} y todos los habitantes de Jerusalén, los sacerdotes y los profetas y todo el pueblo, desde el más pequeño hasta el más grande. Delante de todos ellos leyó en voz alta todas las palabras del libro del pacto que se había encontrado en la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.R: El rey subió al templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. {{gender:Toda la gente de Judá|Todos los hombres de Judá}} y todos los que vivían en Jerusalén fueron con él. También fueron los sacerdotes y los profetas, y todo el pueblo, desde el menos importante hasta el más importante. El rey les leyó en voz alta todo lo que estaba escrito en el libro del pacto que se había encontrado en el templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Et le roi monta [à] la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, et tout homme de Juda et tous les habitants de Jérusalem avec lui, et les prêtres et les prophètes et tout le peuple, du plus petit au plus grand ; et il lut à leurs oreilles toutes les paroles du livre de l’alliance qui avait été trouvé dans la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Le roi monta à la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, et avec lui {{gender:tous les gens de Juda|tous les hommes de Juda}} et tous les habitants de Jérusalem, les prêtres et les prophètes, et tout le peuple, du plus petit au plus grand. Il lut devant eux toutes les paroles du livre de l’alliance qu’on avait trouvé dans la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Le roi est monté au temple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. {{gender:Tous les gens de Juda|Tous les hommes de Juda}} et tous les habitants de Jérusalem l’ont accompagné. Les prêtres et les prophètes sont venus aussi, et tout le peuple, des plus humbles aux plus importants. Le roi leur a lu à haute voix tout ce qui était écrit dans le livre de l’alliance qu’on avait trouvé dans le temple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Naye mfalme akapanda [kwenda] nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, na kila mtu wa Yuda na wakazi wote wa Yerusalemu pamoja naye, na makuhani na manabii na watu wote, wadogo kwa wakubwa; naye akasoma masikioni mwao maneno yote ya kitabu cha agano kilichoonekana katika nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Mfalme alipanda kwenda nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, na pamoja naye wakaenda watu wote wa Yuda na wote walioishi Yerusalemu, makuhani na manabii, na watu wote, tangu mdogo hadi mkubwa. Akasoma wakisikia maneno yote ya kitabu cha agano, kilichokuwa kimepatikana katika nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Mfalme alipanda kwenda hekalu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Watu wote wa Yuda na kila aliyeishi Yerusalemu walikwenda pamoja naye. Makuhani na manabii walikwenda pia, na watu wote, tangu wasio na cheo hadi wenye vyeo vikubwa. Mfalme akawasomea kwa sauti kila kitu kilichoandikwa katika kitabu cha agano kilichopatikana katika hekalu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

vi.L: Vua đi lên nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, cùng với mọi người Giu-đa và mọi dân cư Giê-ru-sa-lem, các thầy tế lễ và các nhà tiên tri, và toàn dân, từ nhỏ đến lớn; vua đọc vào tai họ mọi lời của sách giao ước đã được tìm thấy trong nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.B: Vua đi lên nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, cùng đi với vua có mọi người Giu-đa và mọi người sống tại Giê-ru-sa-lem, các thầy tế lễ và các nhà tiên tri, và toàn dân, từ người nhỏ nhất đến người lớn nhất. Vua đọc cho họ nghe mọi lời của sách giao ước đã được tìm thấy trong nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.R: Vua đi lên đền thờ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Mọi người Giu-đa và mọi người sống tại Giê-ru-sa-lem cùng đi với vua. Các thầy tế lễ và các nhà tiên tri cũng đi, cùng toàn dân, từ người thấp hèn nhất đến người quan trọng nhất. Vua đọc lớn cho họ nghe mọi điều đã chép trong sách giao ước đã được tìm thấy trong đền thờ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.

ko.L: 그리고 왕이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집으로 올라갔고, 유다의 모든 사람과 예루살렘의 모든 주민과 제사장들과 예언자들과 작은 자부터 큰 자까지 모든 백성이 그와 함께 [올라갔다]. 그리고 그가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집에서 발견된 언약책의 모든 말씀을 그들의 귀에 읽어 주었다.
ko.B: 왕이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집으로 올라가자, 유다의 모든 사람과 예루살렘의 모든 주민과 제사장들과 예언자들과 낮은 자에서 높은 자까지 모든 백성이 그와 함께 올라갔다. 왕은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집에서 발견된 언약책의 모든 말씀을 그들이 듣는 앞에서 읽어 주었다.
ko.R: 왕은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 성전으로 올라갔다. 유다의 모든 사람과 예루살렘에 사는 모든 사람이 그와 함께 갔다. 제사장들과 예언자들도 갔고, 지위가 낮은 사람부터 높은 사람까지 모든 백성이 갔다. 왕은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 성전에서 발견된 언약책에 적힌 모든 말씀을 그들에게 소리 내어 읽어 주었다.

pt.L: E o rei subiu [à] casa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, e todo homem de Judá e todos os habitantes de Jerusalém com ele, e os sacerdotes, e os profetas, e todo o povo, desde o pequeno até o grande; e leu aos ouvidos deles todas as palavras do Livro da Aliança que tinha sido achado na casa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}.
pt.B: O rei subiu à casa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, e com ele foram {{gender:todo o povo de Judá|todos os homens de Judá}} e todos os moradores de Jerusalém, os sacerdotes e os profetas, e todo o povo, do menor ao maior. Ele leu em voz alta, para que todos ouvissem, todas as palavras do Livro da Aliança, que tinha sido encontrado na casa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}.
pt.R: O rei subiu ao templo {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}. {{gender:Todo o povo de Judá|Todos os homens de Judá}} e todos os que moravam em Jerusalém foram com ele. Os sacerdotes e os profetas também foram, e todo o povo, desde os mais simples até os mais importantes. O rei leu em voz alta para eles tudo o que estava escrito no Livro da Aliança, que tinha sido encontrado no templo {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}.

decisions.choice: the book of the covenant: the scroll found in the temple
decisions.reason: This is the book that Hilkiah the priest found in the temple, called "the book of the law" in 22:8. It is named here for what it contains: the terms of Yahweh's covenant with Israel, with the curses that fall on those who break it (22:13, 16-17). What Josiah does in this chapter follows the commands of Deuteronomy closely: one place of worship (Deuteronomy 12), no high places, mediums or child sacrifice (Deuteronomy 18:9-12), and the Passover kept at the place Yahweh chooses (Deuteronomy 16:1-8).

decisions.choice: reading the covenant to the people: as Moses did at Sinai
decisions.reason: At Sinai Moses "took the book of the covenant and read it in the hearing of the people", and they promised to obey (Exodus 24:7). Deuteronomy 31:10-13 commands the law to be read before all Israel. Josiah does the same, and the people bind themselves to the covenant in verse 3.

decisions.choice: from small to great: everyone, whatever their rank or age
decisions.reason: The pair names the whole range of people, from the least important to the most important (1 Samuel 5:9; Jeremiah 6:13).

decisions.choice: every man of Judah: the people of Judah as a whole
decisions.reason: "Man of Judah" is used for the people of Judah taken together. The verse goes on to say that "all the people" were there.

decisions.choice: the prophets: the account in Chronicles has "the Levites"
decisions.reason: 2 Chronicles 34:30 tells the same event and names "the priests and the Levites". The text of Kings here has "the priests and the prophets", which is followed.

decisions.choice: all the people of Judah
decisions.reason: The phrase means the people of Judah as a whole (m4), so Balanced and Readable use the inclusive wording, with the traditional form as the alternative. Literal keeps "every man of Judah".

decisions.choice: temple of the LORD
decisions.reason: As throughout these books, Literal and Balanced say "house of the LORD", and Readable says "temple".

decisions.choice: {{gender:toda la gente de Judá|todos los hombres de Judá}}
decisions.reason: The phrase means the people of Judah as a whole (m4), and Spanish has two real wordings, so Balanced and Readable carry the gender setting as the English does; Literal keeps "todo hombre de Judá".

decisions.choice: "tous les gens de Juda" / "tous les hommes de Juda"
alternatives: "tout homme de Juda" without a span
decisions.reason: The phrase means the people of Judah as a whole (m4); as the English, the inclusive default says so, with the Hebrew's "hommes" as the alternative. Literal keeps "tout homme", as the English Literal keeps "every man".

decisions.choice: watu wote wa Yuda; no gender span
decisions.reason: "Watu" covers the whole people of Judah, men and women; Swahili needs no gender span where the English Balanced and Readable have one, and Literal's "kila mtu wa Yuda" is already inclusive.

decisions.choice: mọi người Giu-đa, with no gender span
decisions.reason: "Mọi người Giu-đa" already means the people as a whole, men and women, so the English gender span has no Vietnamese counterpart.

decisions.choice: "유다의 모든 사람" with no gender span
decisions.reason: "사람" already includes men and women, so Korean has no second wording for the English "people/men of Judah" choice.

decisions.choice: o Livro da Aliança (every level)
decisions.reason: For the whole book (also verse 21): the book found in the temple is named here for what it contains (m1), and Portuguese gives it the name Exodus 24:7 gives the book Moses read at Sinai, "o Livro da Aliança", with capitals at every level, so that the reader can hear the echo of Sinai (m2). Readable keeps the name, where at 22:8 it says "o livro do ensino", since here the English Readable keeps "the book of the covenant" too.

decisions.choice: {{gender:todo o povo de Judá|todos os homens de Judá}} (B, R)
decisions.reason: As the English: the phrase means the people of Judah as a whole (m4), so Balanced and Readable use the inclusive wording, with the traditional "todos os homens" as the alternative; Literal keeps "todo homem de Judá".

source.text: וַיַּעֲמֹ֣ד הַ֠מֶּלֶךְ עַֽל־הָ֨עַמּ֜וּד וַיִּכְרֹ֥ת אֶֽת־הַבְּרִ֣ית׀לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֗ה לָלֶ֜כֶת אַחַ֤ר יְהוָה֙ וְלִשְׁמֹ֨ר מִצְוֺתָ֜יו וְאֶת־עֵדְוֺתָ֤יו וְאֶת־חֻקֹּתָיו֙ בְּכָל־לֵ֣ב וּבְכָל־נֶ֔פֶשׁ לְהָקִ֗ים אֶת־דִּבְרֵי֙ הַבְּרִ֣ית הַזֹּ֔את הַכְּתֻבִ֖ים עַל־הַסֵּ֣פֶר הַזֶּ֑ה וַיַּעֲמֹ֥ד כָּל־הָעָ֖ם בַּבְּרִֽית׃

records.literal_gloss: And stood the king by the pillar and cut the covenant before Yahweh, to walk after Yahweh and to keep his commandments and his testimonies and his statutes with all [the] heart and with all [the] soul, to establish [the] words of the covenant the this, the written on the book the this; and stood all the people in the covenant.

en.L: And the king stood by the pillar and made the covenant before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, to walk after {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and to keep {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} commandments and {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} testimonies and {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} statutes with all [the] heart and with all [the] soul, to carry out the words of this covenant that were written in this book; and all the people stood in the covenant.
en.B: The king stood by the pillar and made the covenant in the presence of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}: to follow {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and to keep {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} commandments, {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} decrees and {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} statutes with all his heart and all his being, and so to carry out the words of this covenant written in this book. And all the people committed themselves to the covenant.
en.R: The king stood by the pillar and made a covenant in {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s presence. He promised to follow {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and to obey {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} commands, {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} instructions and {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} laws with all his heart and all his life. He promised to do everything this covenant said, as it was written in this book. And all the people promised to keep the covenant too.

es.L: Y el rey se puso en pie junto a la columna e hizo el pacto delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, de andar en pos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} y de guardar {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} mandamientos, {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} testimonios y {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} estatutos con todo [el] corazón y con toda [el] alma, para cumplir las palabras de este pacto que estaban escritas en este libro; y todo el pueblo se mantuvo en el pacto.
es.B: El rey se puso de pie junto a la columna e hizo el pacto en presencia {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}: seguir {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} y guardar {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} mandamientos, {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} decretos y {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} estatutos con todo su corazón y con todo su ser, y cumplir así las palabras de este pacto escritas en este libro. Y todo el pueblo se comprometió con el pacto.
es.R: El rey se puso de pie junto a la columna e hizo un pacto en presencia {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. Prometió seguir {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} y obedecer {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} mandatos, {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} instrucciones y {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} leyes con todo su corazón y con toda su vida. Prometió hacer todo lo que decía este pacto, tal como estaba escrito en este libro. Y todo el pueblo prometió también cumplir el pacto.

fr.L: Et le roi se tint près de la colonne et conclut l’alliance devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, pour marcher à la suite {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} et garder {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} commandements, {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} témoignages et {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} prescriptions de tout [son] cœur et de toute [son] âme, pour accomplir les paroles de cette alliance écrites dans ce livre ; et tout le peuple se tint dans l’alliance.
fr.B: Le roi se tint près de la colonne et conclut l’alliance en présence {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} : il s’engageait à suivre {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} et à garder {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} commandements, {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} préceptes et {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} prescriptions de tout son cœur et de tout son être, pour accomplir ainsi les paroles de cette alliance écrites dans ce livre. Et tout le peuple s’engagea dans l’alliance.
fr.R: Le roi s’est tenu près de la colonne et il a fait une alliance devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. Il a promis de suivre {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} et d’obéir à {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} commandements, à {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} instructions et à {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} lois, de tout son cœur et de toute sa vie. Il a promis de faire tout ce que disait cette alliance, telle qu’elle était écrite dans ce livre. Et tout le peuple a promis aussi de respecter l’alliance.

sw.L: Naye mfalme akasimama karibu na nguzo, akafanya agano mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kumfuata {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na kuzishika amri {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} na shuhuda {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} na masharti {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} kwa moyo wote na kwa roho yote, kuyatimiza maneno ya agano hili yaliyoandikwa katika kitabu hiki; nao watu wote wakasimama katika agano hilo.
sw.B: Mfalme alisimama karibu na nguzo, akafanya agano mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}: kumfuata {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na kuzishika amri {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}}, maagizo {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} na masharti {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} kwa moyo wake wote na nafsi yake yote, na hivyo kuyatimiza maneno ya agano hili yaliyoandikwa katika kitabu hiki. Na watu wote wakajifunga kwa agano hilo.
sw.R: Mfalme alisimama karibu na nguzo, akafanya agano mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Aliahidi kumfuata {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na kutii amri {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}}, maagizo {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} na sheria {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} kwa moyo wake wote na maisha yake yote. Aliahidi kufanya kila kitu ambacho agano hili lilisema, kama lilivyoandikwa katika kitabu hiki. Na watu wote wakaahidi kulishika agano hilo pia.

vi.L: Vua đứng bên trụ và lập giao ước trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, để đi theo {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và giữ các điều răn, các chứng ước và các luật lệ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} với cả tấm lòng và cả linh hồn, để thực hiện những lời của giao ước này đã chép trong sách này; và toàn dân đứng vào giao ước.
vi.B: Vua đứng bên trụ và lập giao ước trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}: sẽ theo {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, hết lòng hết linh hồn giữ các điều răn, huấn lệnh và luật lệ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, và như vậy thực hiện những lời của giao ước đã chép trong sách này. Toàn dân đều cam kết giữ giao ước ấy.
vi.R: Vua đứng bên trụ và lập giao ước trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Vua hứa sẽ theo {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và hết lòng, hết sức vâng giữ các mệnh lệnh, lời chỉ dẫn và luật lệ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Vua hứa sẽ làm mọi điều giao ước này nói, như đã chép trong sách này. Toàn dân cũng hứa giữ giao ước ấy.

ko.L: 그리고 왕이 기둥 곁에 서서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞에서 언약을 맺었다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 따라 걷고, 온 마음과 온 목숨으로 그분의 계명과 그분의 증거와 그분의 규례를 지켜, 이 책에 기록된 이 언약의 말씀을 이루겠다는 것이었다. 그리고 모든 백성이 그 언약에 섰다.
ko.B: 왕은 기둥 곁에 서서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞에서 언약을 맺었다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 따르고, 온 마음과 온 목숨을 다하여 그분의 계명과 증거와 규례를 지켜서, 이 책에 기록된 언약의 말씀을 실행하겠다는 것이었다. 모든 백성도 그 언약에 동참했다.
ko.R: 왕은 기둥 곁에 서서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞에서 언약을 맺었다. 그는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 따르고, 온 마음과 온 생명을 다해 그분의 명령과 가르침과 법을 지키겠다고 약속했다. 그는 이 책에 기록된 언약의 말씀을 모두 지키겠다고 약속했다. 모든 백성도 그 언약을 지키겠다고 약속했다.

pt.L: E o rei ficou de pé junto à coluna e fez a aliança diante {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, de andar após {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} e de guardar os {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} mandamentos, e os {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} testemunhos, e os {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} estatutos, com todo o coração e com toda a alma, para cumprir as palavras desta aliança escritas neste livro; e todo o povo se firmou na aliança.
pt.B: O rei ficou de pé junto à coluna e fez a aliança na presença {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}: de seguir {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} e de guardar os {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} mandamentos, os {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} decretos e os {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} estatutos, de todo o coração e de toda a alma, e assim cumprir as palavras desta aliança escritas neste livro. E todo o povo se comprometeu com a aliança.
pt.R: O rei ficou de pé junto à coluna e fez uma aliança na presença {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}. Ele prometeu seguir {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} e obedecer aos {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} mandamentos, às {{deity_pronoun:suas|Suas}} instruções e às {{deity_pronoun:suas|Suas}} leis, de todo o coração e com toda a sua vida. Prometeu fazer tudo o que dizia essa aliança, como estava escrito neste livro. E todo o povo também prometeu cumprir a aliança.

decisions.choice: by the pillar: the king's place in the temple court
decisions.reason: The king had a set place by a pillar at the temple, where Joash was shown to the people when he was crowned (11:14). Josiah stands there to make the covenant on behalf of the nation.

decisions.choice: made the covenant before Yahweh: Israel's covenant renewed
decisions.reason: "The covenant" is the bond already known between Yahweh and his people. Making it "before Yahweh" means in his presence, with him as the one to whom the promise is made. Jehoiada had renewed it in the same place after the years of Baal worship (11:17).

decisions.choice: commandments, testimonies and statutes: the whole of the covenant law
decisions.reason: The three words together name all that Yahweh requires (Deuteronomy 6:17). Commandments are what he orders; testimonies are the solemn terms of the covenant, declared before witnesses; statutes are laws laid down for good.

decisions.choice: with all the heart and with all the soul: the words of Deuteronomy
decisions.reason: Deuteronomy asks Israel to love and serve Yahweh "with all your heart and with all your soul" (Deuteronomy 6:5; 10:12; 30:2, 10). Verse 25 says that Josiah did so.

decisions.choice: all the people stood in the covenant: they took their stand on it
decisions.reason: To "stand in" the covenant is to take one's place in it and commit oneself to it. The same verb is used of the king standing by the pillar: king and people both take their stand.

decisions.choice: commandments, testimonies, statutes / commandments, decrees, statutes / commands, instructions, laws
decisions.reason: The wording kept for these words in these books. Balanced "with all his heart and all his being" and Readable "all his life" follow Deuteronomy 6:5, where "soul" means the whole living self.

decisions.choice: He promised ... all the people promised
decisions.reason: Readable says plainly that making a covenant and standing in it meant making a promise.

decisions.choice: "mandamientos, testimonios, estatutos" (L); "mandamientos, decretos, estatutos" (B); "mandatos, instrucciones, leyes" (R)
decisions.reason: One word per level for each of these terms, as in 17:13-15.

decisions.choice: "commandements, témoignages, prescriptions" (L); "commandements, préceptes, prescriptions" (B); "commandements, instructions, lois" (R)
decisions.reason: The covenant words as in 17:13-15, one set per level, following the English at each level.

decisions.choice: amri, shuhuda, masharti (Literal); amri, maagizo, masharti (Balanced); amri, maagizo, sheria (Readable)
decisions.reason: The three law words in a fixed wording per level, following the pattern of 2 Kings 17.

decisions.choice: điều răn, chứng ước, luật lệ (L); điều răn, huấn lệnh, luật lệ (B); mệnh lệnh, lời chỉ dẫn, luật lệ (R)
decisions.reason: The three words for God's law keep the wording used in chapter 17 at each level.

decisions.choice: "계명, 증거, 규례" (L, B); "명령, 가르침, 법" (R); "온 마음과 온 목숨" (L, B), "온 마음과 온 생명" (R)
decisions.reason: The law words keep the wording set in chapter 17; the phrase from Deuteronomy uses "목숨" for *nefesh*, as the John note gives for *psychē*.

decisions.choice: mandamentos, testemunhos, estatutos (L); mandamentos, decretos, estatutos (B); mandamentos, instruções, leis (R)
decisions.reason: The three words for the covenant law (m3) keep the Portuguese of Deuteronomy 6:17 and 1 Kings 2:3 at each level, and "de todo o coração e de toda a alma" (m4) the words of Deuteronomy 6:5 in Portuguese; Readable says "com toda a sua vida", as the English says "all his life". "A aliança" with the article at Literal and Balanced, as 11:17 has it, since the covenant is the one already known (m2).

decisions.choice: se firmou na aliança (L); se comprometeu com a aliança (B); prometeu cumprir a aliança (R)
decisions.reason: To "stand in" the covenant is to take one's stand on it (m5): Literal says "se firmou", which keeps the picture of standing that the king's "ficou de pé" begins; "ficar de pé na aliança" would not be understood in Portuguese.

source.text: וַיְצַ֣ו הַמֶּ֡לֶךְ אֶת־חִלְקִיָּהוּ֩ הַכֹּהֵ֨ן הַגָּד֜וֹל וְאֶת־כֹּהֲנֵ֣י הַמִּשְׁנֶה֮ וְאֶת־שֹׁמְרֵ֣י הַסַּף֒ לְהוֹצִיא֙ מֵהֵיכַ֣ל יְהוָ֔ה אֵ֣ת כָּל־הַכֵּלִ֗ים הָֽעֲשׂוּיִם֙ לַבַּ֣עַל וְלָֽאֲשֵׁרָ֔ה וּלְכֹ֖ל צְבָ֣א הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם וַֽיִּשְׂרְפֵ֞ם מִח֤וּץ לִירוּשָׁלִַ֨ם֙ בְּשַׁדְמ֣וֹת קִדְר֔וֹן וְנָשָׂ֥א אֶת־עֲפָרָ֖ם בֵּֽית־אֵֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: And commanded the king Hilkiah the priest the great and [the] priests of the second [rank] and [the] keepers of the threshold to bring out from [the] temple of Yahweh all the vessels made for Baal and for Asherah and for all [the] host of the heavens; and he burned them outside Jerusalem in [the] fields of Kidron, and carried their dust [to] Bethel.

en.L: And the king commanded Hilkiah the high priest and the priests of the second [rank] and the keepers of the threshold to bring out from the temple of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} all the vessels made for Baal and for Asherah and for all the host of the heavens; and he burned them outside Jerusalem in the fields of Kidron and carried their dust [to] Bethel.
en.B: The king ordered Hilkiah the high priest, the priests next in rank and the keepers of the threshold to bring out of the temple of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} all the objects made for Baal, for Asherah and for all the host of heaven. He burned them outside Jerusalem in the fields of the Kidron Valley and carried their ashes to Bethel.
en.R: The king ordered Hilkiah the high priest, the priests who served under him, and the men who guarded the temple doors to take out of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s temple everything that had been made for worshiping Baal, the goddess Asherah, and the stars in the sky. He burned all of it outside Jerusalem in the fields of the Kidron Valley. Then he carried the ashes to Bethel.

es.L: Y el rey mandó al sumo sacerdote Hilcías, y a los sacerdotes de segundo [rango] y a los guardianes del umbral que sacaran del templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} todos los utensilios hechos para Baal, y para Aserá y para todo el ejército de los cielos; y los quemó fuera de Jerusalén en los campos del Cedrón, y llevó sus cenizas [a] Betel.
es.B: El rey ordenó al sumo sacerdote Hilcías, a los sacerdotes de segundo rango y a los porteros que sacaran del templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} todos los objetos hechos para Baal, para Aserá y para todo el ejército de los cielos. Los quemó fuera de Jerusalén, en los campos del valle del Cedrón, y llevó sus cenizas a Betel.
es.R: El rey le ordenó al sumo sacerdote Hilcías, a los sacerdotes que servían bajo él y a los hombres que cuidaban las puertas del templo que sacaran del templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} todo lo que se había hecho para adorar a Baal, a la diosa Aserá y a las estrellas del cielo. Lo quemó todo fuera de Jerusalén, en los campos del valle del Cedrón. Después llevó las cenizas a Betel.

fr.L: Et le roi ordonna à Hilqiya, le grand prêtre, aux prêtres du second [rang] et aux gardiens du seuil de faire sortir du temple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} tous les objets faits pour Baal, pour Ashéra et pour toute l’armée des cieux ; et il les brûla hors de Jérusalem, dans les champs du Cédron, et il en porta la poussière [à] Béthel.
fr.B: Le roi ordonna à Hilqiya, le grand prêtre, aux prêtres du second rang et aux gardiens du seuil de sortir du temple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} tous les objets fabriqués pour Baal, pour Ashéra et pour toute l’armée des cieux. Il les brûla hors de Jérusalem, dans les champs de la vallée du Cédron, et en emporta les cendres à Béthel.
fr.R: Le roi a ordonné à Hilqiya, le grand prêtre, aux prêtres qui servaient sous ses ordres et aux hommes qui gardaient les portes du temple de sortir du temple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} tout ce qui avait été fabriqué pour adorer Baal, la déesse Ashéra et les étoiles du ciel. Il a tout brûlé hors de Jérusalem, dans les champs de la vallée du Cédron. Ensuite il a emporté les cendres à Béthel.

sw.L: Naye mfalme akamwamuru Hilkia kuhani mkuu na makuhani wa daraja la pili na walinzi wa kizingiti, kutoa katika hekalu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} vyombo vyote vilivyofanywa kwa ajili ya Baali na kwa ajili ya Ashera na kwa ajili ya jeshi lote la mbinguni; akaviteketeza nje ya Yerusalemu katika mashamba ya Kidroni, akayachukua majivu yake [mpaka] Betheli.
sw.B: Mfalme alimwamuru Hilkia kuhani mkuu, makuhani wa daraja la pili na mabawabu, watoe katika hekalu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} vyombo vyote vilivyofanywa kwa ajili ya Baali, Ashera na jeshi lote la mbinguni. Akaviteketeza nje ya Yerusalemu katika mashamba ya bonde la Kidroni, akayachukua majivu yake mpaka Betheli.
sw.R: Mfalme alimwamuru Hilkia kuhani mkuu, makuhani waliofanya kazi chini yake, na walinzi wa milango ya hekalu, watoe katika hekalu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kila kitu kilichofanywa kwa ajili ya kumwabudu Baali, mungu wa kike Ashera, na nyota za angani. Akaviteketeza vyote nje ya Yerusalemu katika mashamba ya bonde la Kidroni. Kisha akayachukua majivu mpaka Betheli.

vi.L: Vua truyền cho thầy tế lễ thượng phẩm Hinh-kia, các thầy tế lễ bậc thứ hai và những người giữ ngưỡng cửa đem ra khỏi đền thờ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} mọi vật dụng đã làm cho Ba-anh, cho A-sê-ra và cho cả cơ binh trên trời; vua đốt chúng bên ngoài Giê-ru-sa-lem trong các cánh đồng Xết-rôn và mang tro [đến] Bê-tên.
vi.B: Vua ra lệnh cho thầy tế lễ thượng phẩm Hinh-kia, các thầy tế lễ phó và những người giữ cửa đem ra khỏi đền thờ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} mọi vật dụng đã làm cho Ba-anh, cho A-sê-ra và cho cả cơ binh trên trời. Vua đốt chúng bên ngoài Giê-ru-sa-lem, trong các cánh đồng của thung lũng Xết-rôn, rồi mang tro đến Bê-tên.
vi.R: Vua ra lệnh cho thầy tế lễ thượng phẩm Hinh-kia, các thầy tế lễ phụ tá và những người canh cửa đền thờ đem ra khỏi đền thờ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} mọi thứ đã làm để thờ Ba-anh, nữ thần A-sê-ra và các ngôi sao trên trời. Vua đốt hết bên ngoài Giê-ru-sa-lem, trong các cánh đồng của thung lũng Xết-rôn. Rồi vua mang tro đến Bê-tên.

ko.L: 그리고 왕이 대제사장 힐기야와 버금 제사장들과 문지기들에게 명령하여, 바알과 아세라와 하늘의 모든 군대를 위하여 만든 모든 기구를 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 성전에서 내오게 했다. 그리고 그가 그것들을 예루살렘 바깥 기드론 들판에서 불사르고, 그 재를 벧엘로 가져갔다.
ko.B: 왕은 대제사장 힐기야와 그다음 서열의 제사장들과 문지기들에게 명령하여, 바알과 아세라와 하늘의 모든 별을 위하여 만든 모든 물건을 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 성전에서 내오게 했다. 그는 그것들을 예루살렘 바깥 기드론 골짜기의 들판에서 불사르고, 그 재를 벧엘로 가져갔다.
ko.R: 왕은 대제사장 힐기야와 그를 돕는 제사장들과 성전 문을 지키는 사람들에게 명령했다. 바알과 아세라 여신과 하늘의 별들을 섬기려고 만든 모든 물건을 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 성전에서 꺼내라는 것이었다. 그는 그것을 모두 예루살렘 바깥 기드론 골짜기의 들판에서 불살랐다. 그리고 그 재를 벧엘로 가져갔다.

pt.L: E o rei ordenou a Hilquias, o sumo sacerdote, e aos sacerdotes de segunda [ordem], e aos guardas da soleira, que tirassem do templo {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} todos os utensílios feitos para o Baal, e para Aserá, e para todo o exército dos céus; e os queimou fora de Jerusalém, nos campos de Cedrom, e levou o pó deles [para] Betel.
pt.B: O rei ordenou ao sumo sacerdote Hilquias, aos sacerdotes que vinham logo abaixo dele e aos guardas da soleira que tirassem do templo {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} todos os objetos feitos para Baal, para Aserá e para todo o exército dos céus. Ele os queimou fora de Jerusalém, nos campos do vale do Cedrom, e levou as cinzas para Betel.
pt.R: O rei ordenou ao sumo sacerdote Hilquias, aos sacerdotes que serviam abaixo dele e aos homens que guardavam as portas do templo que tirassem do templo {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} tudo o que tinha sido feito para adorar o deus Baal, a deusa Aserá e o sol, a lua e as estrelas. Ele queimou tudo isso fora de Jerusalém, nos campos do vale do Cedrom. Depois levou as cinzas para Betel.

decisions.choice: keepers of the threshold: the guards of the temple entrances
decisions.reason: These were senior temple officers who guarded the doors and received gifts brought in (12:10; 22:4). Three of them were taken with the high priest when Jerusalem fell (25:18).

decisions.choice: Baal, Asherah and the host of heaven: the worship Manasseh brought in
decisions.reason: Manasseh had built altars for Baal, made an Asherah, and worshiped all the host of heaven, the sun, moon and stars, even in the courts of the temple (21:3-7). Asherah was a Canaanite goddess (1 Kings 15:13). The vessels were the bowls, stands and other things used in that worship.

decisions.choice: the fields of Kidron: the open ground of the valley east of the city
decisions.reason: The Kidron Valley runs along the east side of Jerusalem. King Asa had burned his mother's image of Asherah there (1 Kings 15:13), and Josiah uses it again in verses 6 and 12.

decisions.choice: carried their dust to Bethel: to defile the north's chief sanctuary
decisions.reason: Bethel was where Jeroboam set up his golden calf and his own altar (1 Kings 12:28-33). Bringing the ashes of idols there made that place unclean too, before Josiah tore its altar down (verse 15).

decisions.choice: the host of the heavens (Literal); the host of heaven (Balanced); the stars in the sky (Readable)
decisions.reason: "Host" means an army: the stars and other lights of the sky pictured as a great company. Readable says what was worshiped.

decisions.choice: the men who guarded the temple doors; the goddess Asherah
decisions.reason: Readable explains the title of the doorkeepers and says who Asherah was.

decisions.choice: "el Cedrón"; "Betel"
decisions.reason: As the terms note's table gives them.

decisions.choice: "le temple du SEIGNEUR" at every level
decisions.reason: The Hebrew has *hekhal* here, the temple building, so French says "temple" at every level, as in 18:16.

decisions.choice: o exército dos céus (L, B); o sol, a lua e as estrelas (R)
decisions.reason: As 21:3 sets it for the book: "o exército dos céus" at Literal and Balanced, and Readable names what was worshiped, as 21:3 does at Readable, where the English Readable here says "the stars in the sky".

decisions.choice: os guardas da soleira (L, B); os homens que guardavam as portas do templo (R)
decisions.reason: The temple officers (m1) keep the words of 22:4 at Literal; Balanced keeps the title too, as the English does here, and Readable says what they did. The Kidron is "Cedrom", as 1 Kings 2:37 sets it.

source.text: וְהִשְׁבִּ֣ית אֶת־הַכְּמָרִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֤ר נָֽתְנוּ֙ מַלְכֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה וַיְקַטֵּ֤ר בַּבָּמוֹת֙ בְּעָרֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה וּמְסִבֵּ֖י יְרוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְאֶת־הַֽמְקַטְּרִ֣ים לַבַּ֗עַל לַשֶּׁ֤מֶשׁ וְלַיָּרֵ֨חַ֙ וְלַמַּזָּל֔וֹת וּלְכֹ֖ל צְבָ֥א הַשָּׁמָֽיִם׃

records.literal_gloss: And he put an end to the idolatrous priests whom had appointed [the] kings of Judah, and he burned incense on the high places in [the] cities of Judah and [the] surroundings of Jerusalem, and those burning incense to Baal, to the sun and to the moon and to the constellations and to all [the] host of the heavens.

en.L: And he put an end to the idolatrous priests whom the kings of Judah had appointed, and [who] burned incense at the high places in the cities of Judah and the surroundings of Jerusalem, and those who burned incense to Baal, to the sun and to the moon and to the constellations and to all the host of the heavens.
en.B: He did away with the idolatrous priests whom the kings of Judah had appointed to burn incense at the high places in the towns of Judah and around Jerusalem, and with those who burned incense to Baal, to the sun and the moon, to the constellations and to all the host of heaven.
en.R: He got rid of the priests who served idols. The kings of Judah had appointed them to burn incense at the hilltop shrines in the towns of Judah and in the places around Jerusalem. He also got rid of the people who burned incense to Baal, to the sun and moon, to the groups of stars, and to all the stars in the sky.

es.L: Y quitó a los sacerdotes idólatras que habían puesto los reyes de Judá, y [que] quemaban incienso en los lugares altos en las ciudades de Judá y en los alrededores de Jerusalén, y a los que quemaban incienso a Baal, al sol, a la luna, a las constelaciones y a todo el ejército de los cielos.
es.B: Acabó con los sacerdotes idólatras que los reyes de Judá habían puesto para quemar incienso en los lugares altos de las ciudades de Judá y de los alrededores de Jerusalén, y con los que quemaban incienso a Baal, al sol y a la luna, a las constelaciones y a todo el ejército de los cielos.
es.R: Echó a los sacerdotes que servían a los ídolos. Los reyes de Judá los habían puesto para quemar incienso en los santuarios sobre las colinas de las ciudades de Judá y de los lugares que rodeaban Jerusalén. También echó a los que quemaban incienso a Baal, al sol y a la luna, a los grupos de estrellas y a todas las estrellas del cielo.

fr.L: Et il supprima les prêtres des idoles qu’avaient établis les rois de Juda, et [qui] brûlaient de l’encens sur les hauts lieux dans les villes de Juda et aux alentours de Jérusalem, et ceux qui brûlaient de l’encens à Baal, au soleil et à la lune, aux constellations et à toute l’armée des cieux.
fr.B: Il destitua les prêtres des idoles que les rois de Juda avaient établis pour brûler de l’encens sur les hauts lieux, dans les villes de Juda et aux alentours de Jérusalem, ainsi que ceux qui brûlaient de l’encens à Baal, au soleil et à la lune, aux constellations et à toute l’armée des cieux.
fr.R: Il a chassé les prêtres qui servaient les idoles. Les rois de Juda les avaient établis pour brûler de l’encens dans les sanctuaires sur les collines, dans les villes de Juda et dans les environs de Jérusalem. Il a aussi chassé ceux qui brûlaient de l’encens à Baal, au soleil et à la lune, aux groupes d’étoiles et à toutes les étoiles du ciel.

sw.L: Naye akawaondoa makuhani wa sanamu, ambao wafalme wa Yuda walikuwa wamewaweka, nao wakafukiza uvumba mahali pa juu katika miji ya Yuda na mazingira ya Yerusalemu, na wale waliomfukizia uvumba Baali, jua na mwezi na makundi ya nyota na jeshi lote la mbinguni.
sw.B: Aliwaondoa makuhani wa sanamu, ambao wafalme wa Yuda walikuwa wamewaweka wafukize uvumba mahali pa juu katika miji ya Yuda na kandokando ya Yerusalemu, pamoja na wale waliomfukizia uvumba Baali, jua na mwezi, makundi ya nyota na jeshi lote la mbinguni.
sw.R: Aliwaondoa makuhani waliotumikia sanamu. Wafalme wa Yuda walikuwa wamewaweka wafukize uvumba katika patakatifu pa kilimani katika miji ya Yuda na mahali palipozunguka Yerusalemu. Aliwaondoa pia watu waliomfukizia uvumba Baali, jua na mwezi, makundi ya nyota, na nyota zote za angani.

vi.L: Vua dẹp bỏ các thầy tế lễ thờ thần tượng mà các vua Giu-đa đã lập, [là những kẻ] đốt hương trên các nơi cao trong các thành Giu-đa và vùng quanh Giê-ru-sa-lem, và những kẻ đốt hương cho Ba-anh, cho mặt trời, cho mặt trăng, cho các chòm sao và cho cả cơ binh trên trời.
vi.B: Vua dẹp bỏ các thầy tế lễ thờ thần tượng mà các vua Giu-đa đã lập để đốt hương trên các nơi cao trong các thành Giu-đa và quanh Giê-ru-sa-lem, cùng những kẻ đốt hương cho Ba-anh, cho mặt trời và mặt trăng, cho các chòm sao và cả cơ binh trên trời.
vi.R: Vua trừ bỏ các thầy tế lễ phục vụ thần tượng. Các vua Giu-đa đã lập họ để đốt hương tại các nơi thờ phượng trên đồi cao trong các thành Giu-đa và những nơi quanh Giê-ru-sa-lem. Vua cũng trừ bỏ những kẻ đốt hương cho Ba-anh, cho mặt trời và mặt trăng, cho các chòm sao và mọi ngôi sao trên trời.

ko.L: 그리고 그가 유다 왕들이 세워서 유다의 성읍들과 예루살렘 주변의 산당들에서 분향하던 우상의 제사장들과, 바알과 해와 달과 별자리들과 하늘의 모든 군대에게 분향하던 자들을 없앴다.
ko.B: 그는 유다 왕들이 세워 유다의 성읍들과 예루살렘 주변의 산당들에서 분향하게 했던 우상의 제사장들을 없애고, 바알과 해와 달과 별자리들과 하늘의 모든 별에게 분향하던 자들도 없앴다.
ko.R: 그는 우상을 섬기는 제사장들을 없앴다. 유다 왕들은 그들을 세워 유다의 성읍들과 예루살렘 주변의 산꼭대기 제단에서 향을 피우게 했다. 그는 바알과 해와 달과 별자리들과 하늘의 모든 별에게 향을 피우던 사람들도 없앴다.

pt.L: E acabou com os sacerdotes idólatras que os reis de Judá tinham posto, e [que] queimavam incenso nos altos, nas cidades de Judá e nos arredores de Jerusalém, e com os que queimavam incenso ao Baal, ao sol, e à lua, e às constelações, e a todo o exército dos céus.
pt.B: Ele acabou com os sacerdotes idólatras que os reis de Judá tinham nomeado para queimar incenso nos altos, nas cidades de Judá e nos arredores de Jerusalém, e com os que queimavam incenso a Baal, ao sol e à lua, às constelações e a todo o exército dos céus.
pt.R: Ele se livrou dos sacerdotes que serviam aos ídolos. Os reis de Judá os tinham nomeado para queimar incenso nos santuários no alto dos morros, nas cidades de Judá e nos lugares em volta de Jerusalém. Ele também se livrou das pessoas que queimavam incenso ao deus Baal, ao sol e à lua, aos grupos de estrelas e a todas as estrelas do céu.

decisions.choice: idolatrous priests: priests who served other gods or idols
decisions.reason: The word used here (kemarim) is not the usual word for priest. In the Old Testament it is used only of priests of idols and other gods: of the calf at Bethel (Hosea 10:5) and of the priests Zephaniah condemns in Josiah's own day (Zephaniah 1:4). It marks them as priests of false worship.

decisions.choice: and he burned incense: the work these priests did
alternatives: whom the kings of Judah had appointed and who burned incense
decisions.reason: The Hebrew verb is singular, "and he burned incense", though the priests are many. It is best taken as describing what they were appointed for: they burned incense at the high places. The ancient translations read a plural, "and they burned incense".

decisions.choice: put an end to: removed them from their office
decisions.reason: The verb means to make something stop. It says that Josiah ended their service, not that he killed them; the priests of the northern shrines are treated differently in verse 20.

decisions.choice: the constellations: groups of stars, perhaps the signs of the zodiac
decisions.reason: The word is found only here. It names star groups that were worshiped, probably the twelve signs through which the sun was seen to pass in the year (compare Job 38:32).

decisions.choice: idolatrous priests (Literal, Balanced); priests who served idols (Readable)
decisions.reason: The English shows that these were not Yahweh's priests (m1). Readable also says "groups of stars" for constellations and "the stars in the sky" for the host of heaven, as in verse 4.

decisions.choice: "sacerdotes idólatras" (L, B); "sacerdotes que servían a los ídolos" (R)
decisions.reason: The wording shows that these were not Yahweh's priests (m1), following the English levels.

decisions.choice: "les prêtres des idoles" (L, B); "les prêtres qui servaient les idoles" (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew has a distinct word for priests of other gods (m1); French marks them by what they served, never with the ordinary "prêtres" alone.

decisions.choice: makuhani wa sanamu (Literal, Balanced); makuhani waliotumikia sanamu (Readable)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word is used only of priests of other gods or idols (meaning decision m1).

decisions.choice: sacerdotes idólatras (L, B); sacerdotes que serviam aos ídolos (R); acabou com (L, B), se livrou de (R)
decisions.reason: The word (m1) names priests of idols only, and Portuguese marks it with "idólatras", as the English says "idolatrous"; "acabar com" says that Josiah ended their service (m3) without saying he killed them, as the verb does not. Readable says "todas as estrelas do céu" at the end, as the English does, since it has named the sun and moon just before.

source.text: וַיֹּצֵ֣א אֶת־הָאֲשֵׁרָה֩ מִבֵּ֨ית יְהוָ֜ה מִח֤וּץ לִירוּשָׁלִַ֨ם֙ אֶל־נַ֣חַל קִדְר֔וֹן וַיִּשְׂרֹ֥ף אֹתָ֛הּ בְּנַ֥חַל קִדְר֖וֹן וַיָּ֣דֶק לְעָפָ֑ר וַיַּשְׁלֵךְ֙ אֶת־עֲפָרָ֔הּ עַל־קֶ֖בֶר בְּנֵ֥י הָעָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And he brought out the Asherah from [the] house of Yahweh outside Jerusalem to [the] valley of Kidron, and burned it in [the] valley of Kidron and ground [it] to dust, and threw its dust on [the] grave[s] of [the] sons of the people.

en.L: And he brought out the Asherah pole from the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, outside Jerusalem, to the Wadi Kidron, and burned it in the Wadi Kidron and ground [it] to dust, and threw its dust on the graves of the sons of the people.
en.B: He took the Asherah pole out of the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} to the Kidron Valley outside Jerusalem. He burned it there in the Kidron Valley, ground it to dust and threw the dust on the graves of the common people.
en.R: He took the pole used to worship Asherah out of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s temple and carried it outside Jerusalem to the Kidron Valley. He burned it there and crushed it into dust. Then he threw the dust on the graves of the common people.

es.L: Y sacó la Aserá de la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, fuera de Jerusalén, al torrente del Cedrón, y la quemó en el torrente del Cedrón y [la] redujo a polvo, y echó su polvo sobre los sepulcros de los hijos del pueblo.
es.B: Sacó el poste de Aserá de la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} y lo llevó al valle del Cedrón, fuera de Jerusalén. Allí, en el valle del Cedrón, lo quemó, lo redujo a polvo y echó el polvo sobre las tumbas de la gente común.
es.R: Sacó del templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} el poste que usaban para adorar a Aserá y lo llevó fuera de Jerusalén, al valle del Cedrón. Allí lo quemó y lo hizo polvo. Luego echó el polvo sobre las tumbas de la gente común.

fr.L: Et il sortit le poteau d’Ashéra de la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, hors de Jérusalem, vers le torrent du Cédron, et il le brûla au torrent du Cédron et le réduisit en poussière, et il jeta sa poussière sur les tombes des fils du peuple.
fr.B: Il sortit le poteau d’Ashéra de la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} et l’emporta hors de Jérusalem, dans la vallée du Cédron. Il le brûla dans la vallée du Cédron, le réduisit en poussière et jeta cette poussière sur les tombes des gens du peuple.
fr.R: Il a sorti du temple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} le poteau sacré de la déesse Ashéra et l’a emporté hors de Jérusalem, dans la vallée du Cédron. Là, il l’a brûlé et l’a réduit en poussière. Ensuite il a jeté cette poussière sur les tombes des gens ordinaires.

sw.L: Naye akautoa mti wa Ashera katika nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, nje ya Yerusalemu, mpaka kijito cha Kidroni, akauteketeza katika kijito cha Kidroni, akausaga kuwa mavumbi, akayatupa mavumbi yake juu ya makaburi ya wana wa watu.
sw.B: Aliutoa mti wa Ashera katika nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na kuupeleka bonde la Kidroni nje ya Yerusalemu. Akauteketeza huko katika bonde la Kidroni, akausaga kuwa mavumbi na kuyatupa mavumbi hayo juu ya makaburi ya watu wa kawaida.
sw.R: Aliitoa nguzo ya kumwabudu mungu wa kike Ashera katika hekalu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, akaipeleka nje ya Yerusalemu mpaka bonde la Kidroni. Akaiteketeza huko na kuiponda kuwa mavumbi. Kisha akayatupa mavumbi hayo juu ya makaburi ya watu wa kawaida.

vi.L: Vua đem trụ A-sê-ra ra khỏi nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, ra ngoài Giê-ru-sa-lem, đến khe Xết-rôn, đốt nó tại khe Xết-rôn, nghiền [nó] thành bụi, và rắc bụi ấy trên mộ của con cái dân chúng.
vi.B: Vua đem trụ A-sê-ra ra khỏi nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đến thung lũng Xết-rôn bên ngoài Giê-ru-sa-lem. Vua đốt nó tại thung lũng Xết-rôn, nghiền nát thành bụi, và rắc bụi ấy trên mộ của thường dân.
vi.R: Vua đem trụ dùng để thờ nữ thần A-sê-ra ra khỏi đền thờ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và mang ra ngoài Giê-ru-sa-lem đến thung lũng Xết-rôn. Vua đốt nó tại đó và nghiền nát thành bụi. Rồi vua rắc bụi ấy trên mộ của thường dân.

ko.L: 그리고 그가 아세라 목상을 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집에서 예루살렘 바깥 기드론 시내로 내다가 기드론 시내에서 불사르고 빻아서 가루로 만들어, 그 가루를 백성의 아들들의 무덤 위에 뿌렸다.
ko.B: 그는 아세라 목상을 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집에서 예루살렘 바깥 기드론 골짜기로 가져가 거기에서 불사르고, 빻아서 가루로 만들어 평민들의 무덤 위에 뿌렸다.
ko.R: 그는 아세라를 섬기는 데 쓰던 목상을 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 성전에서 꺼내어 예루살렘 바깥 기드론 골짜기로 가져갔다. 그는 거기에서 그것을 불사르고 부수어 가루로 만들었다. 그리고 그 가루를 평민들의 무덤 위에 뿌렸다.

pt.L: E tirou o poste de Aserá da casa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} para fora de Jerusalém, ao ribeiro de Cedrom, e o queimou no ribeiro de Cedrom, e [o] reduziu a pó, e lançou o seu pó sobre as sepulturas dos filhos do povo.
pt.B: Ele tirou o poste de Aserá da casa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} e o levou para o vale do Cedrom, fora de Jerusalém. Ali, no vale do Cedrom, ele o queimou, o reduziu a pó e jogou o pó sobre as sepulturas do povo comum.
pt.R: Ele tirou do templo {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} o poste usado para adorar a deusa Aserá e o levou para fora de Jerusalém, ao vale do Cedrom. Ali ele o queimou e o transformou em pó. Depois jogou o pó sobre as sepulturas do povo comum.

decisions.choice: the Asherah: the image Manasseh set up in the temple
decisions.reason: Manasseh had made an image of Asherah and set it up in the house of which Yahweh had said "I will put my name there" (21:7). Josiah removes it from the temple and destroys it completely.

decisions.choice: the graves of the common people: a public burial ground
decisions.reason: The common people were buried in a shared burial place in the Kidron Valley (Jeremiah 26:23). Throwing the idol's dust there treated it as something unclean, fit only for the place of the dead. 2 Chronicles 34:4 says the dust was scattered on the graves of those who had sacrificed to the idols.

decisions.choice: the sons of the people: ordinary people
decisions.reason: "Sons of the people" means the common people, as distinct from the king's household and the leading families.

decisions.choice: the pole used to worship Asherah
decisions.reason: The wording kept for this word in these books. Literal and Balanced say "Asherah pole" for the singular "the Asherah", as at 18:4.

decisions.choice: "los hijos del pueblo" (L); "la gente común" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew phrase; Balanced and Readable say what it means, ordinary people (m3).

decisions.choice: "le torrent du Cédron" (L); "la vallée du Cédron" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Kidron is a wadi (*naḥal*); French uses "torrent" at Literal and "vallée" at Balanced and Readable, as the Samuel drafts do.

decisions.choice: wana wa watu
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew "sons of the people", ordinary people (meaning decision m3); "Kijito cha Kidroni" for the wadi at Literal, "bonde" at Balanced and Readable, as in 2 Samuel 15.

decisions.choice: khe Xết-rôn (L); thung lũng Xết-rôn (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "khe", the form of the terms note and John 18:1, for the Hebrew wadi; Balanced and Readable say "thung lũng", as the English says "valley".

decisions.choice: o poste de Aserá (L, B), o poste usado para adorar a deusa Aserá (R); o ribeiro de Cedrom (L), o vale do Cedrom (B, R); os filhos do povo (L), o povo comum (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Asherah pole keeps the wording 1 Kings 14:15 and 21:3 set for the book at each level, and the Kidron that of 1 Kings 2:37. Literal keeps the idiom "filhos do povo" (m3), and Balanced and Readable say what it means.

source.text: וַיִּתֹּץ֙ אֶת־בָּתֵּ֣י הַקְּדֵשִׁ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּבֵ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר הַנָּשִׁ֗ים אֹרְג֥וֹת שָׁ֛ם בָּתִּ֖ים לָאֲשֵׁרָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And he tore down [the] houses of the male cult prostitutes which [were] in [the] house of Yahweh, where the women [were] weaving there houses for Asherah.

en.L: And he tore down the houses of the male cult prostitutes that [were] in the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, where the women were weaving houses for Asherah.
en.B: He tore down the quarters of the male shrine prostitutes in the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, where the women wove coverings for Asherah.
en.R: He tore down the rooms in {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s temple used by the men who served as prostitutes at the shrines. In those rooms the women wove coverings for the goddess Asherah.

es.L: Y derribó las casas de los prostitutos de culto que [estaban] en la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, donde las mujeres tejían casas para Aserá.
es.B: Derribó los aposentos de los prostitutos del santuario que estaban en la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, donde las mujeres tejían cortinas para Aserá.
es.R: Derribó los cuartos del templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} que usaban los hombres que se prostituían en los santuarios. En esos cuartos las mujeres tejían cortinas para la diosa Aserá.

fr.L: Et il démolit les maisons des prostitués sacrés qui [étaient] dans la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, où les femmes tissaient des maisons pour Ashéra.
fr.B: Il démolit les logements des prostitués sacrés qui se trouvaient dans la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, et où les femmes tissaient des tentures pour Ashéra.
fr.R: Il a démoli les chambres du temple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} qu’utilisaient les hommes qui se prostituaient dans les sanctuaires. Dans ces chambres, les femmes tissaient des tentures pour la déesse Ashéra.

sw.L: Naye akazibomoa nyumba za wanaume makahaba wa ibada zilizokuwa katika nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, ambapo wanawake walikuwa wakifuma nyumba kwa ajili ya Ashera.
sw.B: Alizibomoa nyumba za wanaume makahaba wa mahali pa ibada zilizokuwa katika nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, ambapo wanawake walifuma mapazia kwa ajili ya Ashera.
sw.R: Alivibomoa vyumba vilivyokuwa ndani ya hekalu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, vilivyotumiwa na wanaume waliofanya ukahaba katika mahali pa ibada. Katika vyumba hivyo wanawake walikuwa wakifuma mapazia kwa ajili ya mungu wa kike Ashera.

vi.L: Vua phá đổ các nhà của bọn nam mại dâm nơi đền miếu ở trong nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, là nơi các phụ nữ dệt nhà cho A-sê-ra.
vi.B: Vua phá đổ các phòng của bọn nam mại dâm nơi đền miếu trong nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, là nơi các phụ nữ dệt màn cho A-sê-ra.
vi.R: Vua phá đổ các phòng trong đền thờ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} mà những người đàn ông làm nghề mại dâm tại các miếu thờ đã dùng. Trong các phòng ấy, các phụ nữ dệt màn cho nữ thần A-sê-ra.

ko.L: 그리고 그가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집에 있던 남창들의 집들을 헐었다. 그곳에서 여자들이 아세라를 위하여 집들을 짜고 있었다.
ko.B: 그는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집에 있던 신전 남창들의 처소를 헐었다. 그곳에서 여자들이 아세라를 위한 휘장을 짜고 있었다.
ko.R: 그는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 성전 안에 있던 방들을 헐었다. 그 방들은 신당에서 몸을 파는 남자들이 쓰던 곳이었다. 그 방들에서 여자들이 아세라 여신을 위한 휘장을 짜고 있었다.

pt.L: E derrubou as casas dos prostitutos cultuais que [estavam] na casa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, onde as mulheres teciam casas para Aserá.
pt.B: Ele derrubou os aposentos dos prostitutos cultuais que ficavam na casa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, onde as mulheres teciam coberturas para Aserá.
pt.R: Ele derrubou as salas do templo {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} usadas pelos homens que serviam como prostitutos nos santuários. Nessas salas as mulheres teciam coberturas para a deusa Aserá.

decisions.choice: male cult prostitutes: men attached to the shrines, probably for sexual rites
decisions.reason: As in 1 Kings 14:24 and 15:12, the word means "consecrated ones", men set apart for a shrine. The law forbids them (Deuteronomy 23:18). They are usually taken to be men who served as prostitutes in the worship of other gods, though some think the word means shrine servants in a wider sense.

decisions.choice: houses for Asherah: woven hangings or coverings for the image
decisions.reason: The word is the ordinary word for "houses". What the women wove was perhaps tent-like hangings that sheltered the image of Asherah, or clothing for the image itself; Jeremiah 10:9 speaks of idols dressed in blue and purple cloth. The exact sense is not known.

decisions.choice: houses in the house of Yahweh: rooms or quarters in the temple courts
decisions.reason: The temple courts had side rooms and buildings (1 Kings 6:5; Jeremiah 35:4). Some of these had been given over to the worship of Asherah, even within the temple area.

decisions.choice: male cult prostitutes (Literal); male shrine prostitutes (Balanced); men who worked as prostitutes at the shrines (Readable)
decisions.reason: The wording used for this word at 1 Kings 14:24.

decisions.choice: quarters, coverings (Balanced); rooms, coverings (Readable)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "houses" both times. Balanced and Readable say what the houses were in each place: rooms in the temple courts, and woven coverings for the image (m2, m3).

decisions.choice: "prostitutos de culto" (L); "prostitutos del santuario" (B); "los hombres que se prostituían en los santuarios" (R); "casas" (L), "cortinas" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The wording follows the English levels for this word; Balanced and Readable say what the "houses" for Asherah were, woven coverings (m2).

decisions.choice: "prostitués sacrés" (L, B); "hommes qui se prostituaient dans les sanctuaires" (R)
decisions.reason: Men attached to the shrines (m1); the masculine plural of "prostitué" marks that they were men.

decisions.choice: wanaume makahaba wa ibada (Literal); wanaume makahaba wa mahali pa ibada (Balanced); wanaume waliofanya ukahaba katika mahali pa ibada (Readable)
decisions.reason: Men attached to the shrines for sexual rites (meaning decision m1), said plainly; "mahanithi" was avoided because in today's Swahili it names a man's sexuality, not this office.

decisions.choice: nyumba (for Asherah)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew "houses"; Balanced and Readable say woven coverings (meaning decision m2).

decisions.choice: "남창" (L), "신전 남창" (B), "신당에서 몸을 파는 남자들" (R); "집들" (L), "휘장" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Korean names the role plainly at each level, as the English does; Literal keeps the Hebrew "houses" for what the women wove, and Balanced and Readable say coverings.

decisions.choice: os prostitutos cultuais (L, B); homens que serviam como prostitutos nos santuários (R); casas (L), coberturas (B, R)
decisions.reason: The men attached to the shrines (m1) keep the words 1 Kings 22:47 sets for Kings, "prostitutos cultuais" at Literal and Balanced and the explanation at Readable. Literal keeps "casas" both times, and Balanced and Readable say what the woven "houses" were (m2), as the English does.

source.text: וַיָּבֵ֤א אֶת־כָּל־הַכֹּֽהֲנִים֙ מֵעָרֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה וַיְטַמֵּ֣א אֶת־הַבָּמ֗וֹת אֲשֶׁ֤ר קִטְּרוּ־שָׁ֨מָּה֙ הַכֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים מִגֶּ֖בַע עַד־בְּאֵ֣ר שָׁ֑בַע וְנָתַ֞ץ אֶת־בָּמ֣וֹת הַשְּׁעָרִ֗ים אֲשֶׁר־פֶּ֜תַח שַׁ֤עַר יְהוֹשֻׁ֨עַ֙ שַׂר־הָעִ֔יר אֲשֶֽׁר־עַל־שְׂמֹ֥אול אִ֖ישׁ בְּשַׁ֥עַר הָעִֽיר׃

records.literal_gloss: And he brought all the priests from [the] cities of Judah, and defiled the high places where had burned incense there the priests, from Geba to Beersheba; and he broke down [the] high places of the gates which [were at the] entrance of [the] gate of Joshua [the] governor of the city, which [was] on [the] left of a man in [the] gate of the city.

en.L: And he brought all the priests from the cities of Judah and defiled the high places where the priests had burned incense, from Geba to Beersheba; and he broke down the high places of the gates that [were at the] entrance of the gate of Joshua the governor of the city, which [was] on a man's left at the gate of the city.
en.B: He brought all the priests in from the towns of Judah and defiled the high places where those priests had burned incense, from Geba to Beersheba. He broke down the high places of the gates that stood at the way into the Gate of Joshua, the city governor, on the left as one enters the city gate.
en.R: Josiah brought to Jerusalem all the priests from the towns of Judah. He made unclean the hilltop shrines where they had burned incense, from Geba in the north to Beersheba in the south. He also tore down the shrines at the gates. They stood at the entrance of the Gate of Joshua, the city governor, on the left as you went in through the city gate.

es.L: Y trajo a todos los sacerdotes de las ciudades de Judá, y profanó los lugares altos donde los sacerdotes habían quemado incienso, desde Geba hasta Beerseba; y derribó los lugares altos de las puertas que [estaban a la] entrada de la puerta de Josué, gobernador de la ciudad, que [estaba] a la izquierda de uno a la puerta de la ciudad.
es.B: Trajo a todos los sacerdotes de las ciudades de Judá y profanó los lugares altos donde esos sacerdotes habían quemado incienso, desde Geba hasta Beerseba. Derribó los lugares altos de las puertas que estaban a la entrada de la puerta de Josué, gobernador de la ciudad, a la izquierda de quien entra por la puerta de la ciudad.
es.R: Josías llevó a Jerusalén a todos los sacerdotes de las ciudades de Judá. Profanó los santuarios sobre las colinas donde habían quemado incienso, desde Geba en el norte hasta Beerseba en el sur. También derribó los santuarios de las puertas. Estaban a la entrada de la puerta de Josué, el gobernador de la ciudad, a la izquierda de quien entraba por la puerta de la ciudad.

fr.L: Et il fit venir tous les prêtres des villes de Juda, et il profana les hauts lieux où les prêtres avaient brûlé de l’encens, depuis Guéba jusqu’à Beer-Shéba ; et il démolit les hauts lieux des portes qui [étaient à] l’entrée de la porte de Josué, gouverneur de la ville, qui [était] à gauche d’un homme à la porte de la ville.
fr.B: Il fit venir tous les prêtres des villes de Juda et profana les hauts lieux où ces prêtres avaient brûlé de l’encens, depuis Guéba jusqu’à Beer-Shéba. Il démolit les hauts lieux des portes, qui se trouvaient à l’entrée de la porte de Josué, le gouverneur de la ville, à gauche quand on franchit la porte de la ville.
fr.R: Josias a fait venir à Jérusalem tous les prêtres des villes de Juda. Il a rendu impurs les sanctuaires sur les collines où ils avaient brûlé de l’encens, depuis Guéba au nord jusqu’à Beer-Shéba au sud. Il a aussi démoli les sanctuaires des portes. Ils se trouvaient à l’entrée de la porte de Josué, le gouverneur de la ville, à gauche quand on passait la porte de la ville.

sw.L: Naye akawaleta makuhani wote kutoka miji ya Yuda, akapanajisi mahali pa juu ambapo makuhani walifukiza uvumba, tangu Geba mpaka Beer-sheba; naye akabomoa mahali pa juu pa malango palipokuwa mlangoni pa lango la Yoshua mkuu wa mji, palipokuwa upande wa kushoto wa mtu katika lango la mji.
sw.B: Aliwaleta makuhani wote kutoka miji ya Yuda, akapanajisi mahali pa juu ambapo makuhani hao walifukiza uvumba, tangu Geba mpaka Beer-sheba. Akabomoa mahali pa juu pa malango palipokuwa kwenye njia ya kuingia Lango la Yoshua, mkuu wa mji, upande wa kushoto mtu anapoingia katika lango la mji.
sw.R: Yosia aliwaleta Yerusalemu makuhani wote kutoka miji ya Yuda. Akapatia unajisi patakatifu pa kilimani ambapo walifukiza uvumba, tangu Geba upande wa kaskazini mpaka Beer-sheba upande wa kusini. Pia alibomoa patakatifu palipokuwa karibu na malango. Palikuwa kwenye mlango wa Lango la Yoshua, mkuu wa mji, upande wa kushoto unapoingia katika lango la mji.

vi.L: Vua đem tất cả các thầy tế lễ từ các thành Giu-đa về, và làm ô uế các nơi cao, nơi các thầy tế lễ đã đốt hương, từ Ghê-ba đến Bê-e-Sê-ba; vua phá đổ các nơi cao ở các cổng, [nơi] lối vào cổng Giô-suê, quan cai thành, ở bên trái người ta tại cổng thành.
vi.B: Vua đem tất cả các thầy tế lễ từ các thành Giu-đa về, và làm ô uế các nơi cao mà các thầy tế lễ ấy đã đốt hương, từ Ghê-ba đến Bê-e-Sê-ba. Vua phá đổ các nơi cao ở các cổng, nơi lối vào Cổng Giô-suê, quan cai thành, ở bên trái khi người ta đi vào cổng thành.
vi.R: Giô-si-a đem tất cả các thầy tế lễ từ các thành Giu-đa về Giê-ru-sa-lem. Vua làm ô uế các nơi thờ phượng trên đồi cao nơi họ đã đốt hương, từ Ghê-ba ở phía bắc đến Bê-e-Sê-ba ở phía nam. Vua cũng phá đổ các miếu ở các cổng. Các miếu ấy ở lối vào Cổng Giô-suê, quan cai thành, bên tay trái khi đi vào cổng thành.

ko.L: 그리고 그가 유다 성읍들에서 모든 제사장을 데려오고, 게바에서 브엘세바까지 제사장들이 분향하던 산당들을 더럽혔다. 그리고 그가 성읍의 성주 여호수아의 문 어귀에 있던 성문의 산당들을 헐었다. 그것은 성문에 들어가는 사람의 왼쪽에 있었다.
ko.B: 그는 유다 성읍들에서 모든 제사장을 데려오고, 게바에서 브엘세바까지 그 제사장들이 분향하던 산당들을 더럽혔다. 그는 또 성문들의 산당들을 헐었다. 그것들은 성주 여호수아의 문으로 들어가는 어귀, 곧 성문에 들어갈 때 왼쪽에 있었다.
ko.R: 요시야는 유다 성읍들에 있던 모든 제사장을 예루살렘으로 데려왔다. 그리고 북쪽 게바에서 남쪽 브엘세바까지 그들이 향을 피우던 산꼭대기 제단들을 더럽혀 쓰지 못하게 했다. 그는 또 성문 곁에 있던 산당들도 헐었다. 그것들은 성주 여호수아의 문 어귀, 곧 성문으로 들어갈 때 왼쪽에 있었다.

pt.L: E trouxe todos os sacerdotes das cidades de Judá e contaminou os altos onde os sacerdotes tinham queimado incenso, desde Geba até Berseba; e derrubou os altos das portas que [estavam] à entrada da porta de Josué, o governador da cidade, que [ficava] à esquerda de quem [entra] pela porta da cidade.
pt.B: Ele trouxe para Jerusalém todos os sacerdotes das cidades de Judá e tornou impuros os altos onde esses sacerdotes tinham queimado incenso, desde Geba até Berseba. Derrubou também os altos das portas, que ficavam na entrada da Porta de Josué, o governador da cidade, à esquerda de quem entra pela porta da cidade.
pt.R: Josias trouxe para Jerusalém todos os sacerdotes das cidades de Judá. Ele tornou impuros os santuários no alto dos morros onde eles tinham queimado incenso, desde Geba, no norte, até Berseba, no sul. Também derrubou os santuários que ficavam junto às portas. Eles estavam na entrada da Porta de Josué, o governador da cidade, à esquerda de quem entrava pela porta da cidade.

decisions.choice: he brought the priests in: worship gathered to one place
decisions.reason: Deuteronomy 12 commands sacrifice only at the one place Yahweh chooses. Josiah brings the priests of the country shrines to Jerusalem and makes the shrines unusable, so that worship is gathered at the temple.

decisions.choice: from Geba to Beersheba: the whole of Judah, north to south
decisions.reason: Geba, in Benjamin, was on Judah's northern border (1 Kings 15:22); Beersheba was in the far south. The phrase means the whole land of Judah, as "from Dan to Beersheba" meant all Israel.

decisions.choice: defiled: made unfit for worship
decisions.reason: To defile a place of worship is to make it ritually unclean so that sacrifice can no longer be offered there. Verses 14, 16 and 20 show one way this was done, with human bones.

decisions.choice: the high places of the gates: shrines beside the city gates
alternatives: the high places of the goat-demons
decisions.reason: The Hebrew reads "the high places of the gates": shrines at the city gates. With a small change of letters the words would read "the high places of the goat-demons", the goat-idols forbidden in Leviticus 17:7. The Hebrew as it stands makes sense and is followed.

decisions.choice: on a man's left: on the left of someone entering
decisions.reason: The directions are given from the point of view of a person going in through the city gate.

decisions.choice: to Jerusalem; in the north ... in the south
decisions.reason: Readable says where the priests were brought and what the two place names mark.

decisions.choice: "profanó" at every level; "desde Geba hasta Beerseba"
decisions.reason: "Profanar" says that the places were made unfit for worship (m3); "Beerseba" as the Samuel terms note's "desde Dan hasta Beerseba".

decisions.choice: kupanajisi (Literal, Balanced); kupatia unajisi (Readable)
decisions.reason: "Defile" is the ritual word, making a place unfit for worship (meaning decision m3); Swahili "unajisi" is the word of the published Leviticus.

decisions.choice: contaminou (L); tornou impuros (B, R)
decisions.reason: Defiling a place of worship (m3) made it ritually unclean; Literal says "contaminou", and Balanced and Readable use "impuro", the word the Old Testament terms set for ritual uncleanness, so the reader sees the link with the bones of verses 14, 16 and 20. "Geba" and "Berseba" as 1 Kings 15:22 and Genesis 21:31 in Portuguese.

source.text: אַ֗ךְ לֹ֤א יַֽעֲלוּ֙ כֹּהֲנֵ֣י הַבָּמ֔וֹת אֶל־מִזְבַּ֥ח יְהוָ֖ה בִּירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם כִּ֛י אִם־אָכְל֥וּ מַצּ֖וֹת בְּת֥וֹךְ אֲחֵיהֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: Only not went up [the] priests of the high places to [the] altar of Yahweh in Jerusalem, but they ate unleavened bread(s) among their brothers.

en.L: However, the priests of the high places did not go up to the altar of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} in Jerusalem, but they ate unleavened bread among their brothers.
en.B: The priests of the high places did not serve at the altar of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} in Jerusalem, but they ate unleavened bread with their fellow priests.
en.R: The priests from the hilltop shrines were not allowed to serve at {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s altar in Jerusalem. But they ate the bread made without yeast along with the other priests.

es.L: Sin embargo, los sacerdotes de los lugares altos no subían al altar {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} en Jerusalén, sino que comían panes sin levadura entre sus hermanos.
es.B: Los sacerdotes de los lugares altos no servían en el altar {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} en Jerusalén, pero comían panes sin levadura con sus compañeros sacerdotes.
es.R: A los sacerdotes de los santuarios sobre las colinas no se les permitía servir en el altar {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} en Jerusalén. Pero comían el pan sin levadura junto con los demás sacerdotes.

fr.L: Cependant les prêtres des hauts lieux ne montaient pas à l’autel {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} à Jérusalem, mais ils mangeaient des pains sans levain parmi leurs frères.
fr.B: Les prêtres des hauts lieux ne servaient pas à l’autel {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} à Jérusalem, mais ils mangeaient des pains sans levain avec les autres prêtres.
fr.R: Les prêtres des sanctuaires sur les collines n’avaient pas le droit de servir à l’autel {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} à Jérusalem. Mais ils mangeaient le pain sans levain avec les autres prêtres.

sw.L: Lakini makuhani wa mahali pa juu hawakupanda kwenye madhabahu ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} huko Yerusalemu, bali walikula mikate isiyotiwa chachu kati ya ndugu zao.
sw.B: Makuhani wa mahali pa juu hawakuhudumu kwenye madhabahu ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} huko Yerusalemu, lakini walikula mikate isiyotiwa chachu pamoja na makuhani wenzao.
sw.R: Makuhani waliotoka patakatifu pa kilimani hawakuruhusiwa kuhudumu kwenye madhabahu ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} huko Yerusalemu. Lakini walikula mikate isiyotiwa chachu pamoja na makuhani wengine.

vi.L: Tuy nhiên, các thầy tế lễ của các nơi cao không đi lên bàn thờ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} tại Giê-ru-sa-lem, nhưng họ ăn bánh không men giữa anh em mình.
vi.B: Các thầy tế lễ của các nơi cao không được phục vụ tại bàn thờ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ở Giê-ru-sa-lem, nhưng họ ăn bánh không men với các thầy tế lễ anh em mình.
vi.R: Các thầy tế lễ từ các nơi thờ phượng trên đồi cao không được phép phục vụ tại bàn thờ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ở Giê-ru-sa-lem. Nhưng họ được ăn bánh không men cùng với các thầy tế lễ khác.

ko.L: 다만 산당의 제사장들은 예루살렘에 있는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 제단에 올라가지 못했다. 그러나 그들은 그들의 형제들 가운데서 누룩 없는 빵을 먹었다.
ko.B: 산당의 제사장들은 예루살렘에 있는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 제단에서 섬기지는 못했으나, 그들의 동료 제사장들과 함께 누룩 없는 빵을 먹었다.
ko.R: 산꼭대기 제단의 제사장들은 예루살렘에 있는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 제단에서 섬기지 못하게 되었다. 그러나 그들은 다른 제사장들과 함께 누룩 넣지 않은 빵을 먹었다.

pt.L: Porém os sacerdotes dos altos não subiam ao altar {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} em Jerusalém, mas comiam pães sem fermento no meio dos seus irmãos.
pt.B: Os sacerdotes dos altos não serviam no altar {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} em Jerusalém, mas comiam pães sem fermento com os seus colegas sacerdotes.
pt.R: Os sacerdotes dos santuários no alto dos morros não tinham permissão para servir no altar {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} em Jerusalém. Mas comiam o pão sem fermento junto com os outros sacerdotes.

decisions.choice: go up to the altar: serve at it as priests
decisions.reason: The altar stood high, and a priest "went up" to it to offer sacrifices (1 Kings 12:32-33). These priests were not allowed to do the work of priests at the temple.

decisions.choice: ate unleavened bread among their brothers: they shared the priests' food
decisions.reason: Priests lived on their share of the offerings, and the grain offering was eaten as unleavened bread by the priests (Leviticus 6:9-11). These priests were fed from the priests' portion, though they could not serve.

decisions.choice: Deuteronomy 18:6-8: Levites from the towns serving at the chosen place
decisions.reason: Deuteronomy allows a Levite from any town of Israel who comes to the chosen place to serve there and eat an equal share. The priests of Judah's high places were given a share but not the service, since they had served at forbidden shrines.

decisions.choice: their brothers: their fellow priests
decisions.reason: "Brothers" here means their kinsmen in the priesthood, the priests who served at the temple.

decisions.choice: were not allowed to serve
decisions.reason: Readable makes clear that this was not their choice. The Hebrew says only that they "did not go up", but the contrast with Deuteronomy 18:6-8 (m3) shows that they were kept from serving.

decisions.choice: os seus irmãos (L); os seus colegas sacerdotes (B); os outros sacerdotes (R)
decisions.reason: "Irmãos" here means fellow priests (m4); Literal keeps the word, and Balanced and Readable say who they were, as the English "fellow priests" does.

source.text: וְטִמֵּ֣א אֶת־הַתֹּ֔פֶת אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּגֵ֣י בֶן־הִנֹּ֑ם לְבִלְתִּ֗י לְהַעֲבִ֨יר אִ֜ישׁ אֶת־בְּנ֧וֹ וְאֶת־בִּתּ֛וֹ בָּאֵ֖שׁ לַמֹּֽלֶךְ׃

records.literal_gloss: And he defiled the Topheth which [is] in [the] valley of Ben-hinnom, so that not to make pass a man his son or his daughter in the fire to Molech.

en.L: And he defiled Topheth, which [is] in the Valley of Ben-hinnom, so that no one might make his son or his daughter pass through the fire to Molech.
en.B: He defiled Topheth in the Valley of Ben-hinnom, so that no one would ever again make a son or daughter pass through the fire for Molech.
en.R: He made Topheth unclean. It was in the Valley of Ben-hinnom. He did this so that no one could ever again burn their son or daughter in the fire as a sacrifice to Molech.

es.L: Y profanó el Tofet, que [está] en el valle de Ben-hinom, para que nadie hiciera pasar a su hijo o a su hija por el fuego a Moloc.
es.B: Profanó el Tofet, en el valle de Ben-hinom, para que nadie volviera a hacer pasar a su hijo o a su hija por el fuego en honor de Moloc.
es.R: Profanó el Tofet, que estaba en el valle de Ben-hinom. Lo hizo para que nadie volviera a quemar a su hijo o a su hija en el fuego como sacrificio a Moloc.

fr.L: Et il profana le Topheth qui [est] dans la vallée de Ben-Hinnom, pour que personne ne fasse plus passer son fils ou sa fille par le feu pour Molek.
fr.B: Il profana le Topheth, dans la vallée de Ben-Hinnom, pour que personne ne fasse plus jamais passer son fils ou sa fille par le feu en l’honneur de Molek.
fr.R: Il a rendu impur le Topheth. Il se trouvait dans la vallée de Ben-Hinnom. Il a fait cela pour que personne ne puisse plus jamais brûler son fils ou sa fille dans le feu, en sacrifice à Molek.

sw.L: Naye akapanajisi Tofethi, iliyo katika bonde la Ben-hinomu, ili mtu yeyote asimpitishe mwanawe au binti yake motoni kwa Moleki.
sw.B: Alipanajisi Tofethi katika Bonde la Ben-hinomu, ili mtu yeyote asimpitishe tena mwana wala binti motoni kwa ajili ya Moleki.
sw.R: Alipatia unajisi Tofethi. Palikuwa katika Bonde la Ben-hinomu. Alifanya hivyo ili mtu yeyote asiweze tena kumchoma mwanawe au binti yake motoni kuwa dhabihu kwa Moleki.

vi.L: Vua làm ô uế Tô-phết ở trong thung lũng Bên Hi-nôm, để không ai cho con trai hay con gái mình đi qua lửa cho Mo-lóc nữa.
vi.B: Vua làm ô uế Tô-phết trong thung lũng Bên Hi-nôm, để không ai còn cho con trai hay con gái mình đi qua lửa dâng cho Mo-lóc nữa.
vi.R: Vua làm ô uế Tô-phết, ở trong thung lũng Bên Hi-nôm. Vua làm vậy để không ai còn thiêu con trai hay con gái mình trong lửa làm sinh tế dâng cho thần Mo-lóc nữa.

ko.L: 그리고 그가 벤힌놈 골짜기에 있는 도벳을 더럽혀, 아무도 자기 아들이나 딸을 몰렉에게 불 가운데로 지나가게 하지 못하게 했다.
ko.B: 그는 벤힌놈 골짜기에 있는 도벳을 더럽혀, 다시는 아무도 자기 아들이나 딸을 몰렉에게 불 가운데로 지나가게 하지 못하게 했다.
ko.R: 그는 도벳을 더럽혔다. 도벳은 벤힌놈 골짜기에 있었다. 그는 다시는 아무도 자기 아들이나 딸을 몰렉에게 불에 태워 바치지 못하게 하려고 그렇게 했다.
