vi.R: Chưa từng có Lễ Vượt Qua nào được cử hành như thế, từ thời các thủ lĩnh lãnh đạo Y-sơ-ra-ên, cũng như suốt những năm các vua cai trị Y-sơ-ra-ên và Giu-đa.

ko.L: 이스라엘을 다스리던 사사들의 날들부터, 그리고 이스라엘 왕들과 유다 왕들의 모든 날 동안 이 유월절과 같은 [유월절]이 지켜진 적이 없었다.
ko.B: 이스라엘을 다스리던 사사들의 시대부터 이스라엘 왕들과 유다 왕들의 시대 내내, 이와 같은 유월절을 지킨 적이 없었다.
ko.R: 사사들이 이스라엘을 이끌던 때부터 왕들이 이스라엘과 유다를 다스리던 모든 시대에 이르기까지, 이렇게 유월절을 지킨 적이 한 번도 없었다.

pt.L: Porque não tinha sido celebrada [uma Páscoa] como esta Páscoa desde os dias dos juízes que julgaram Israel, nem [em] todos os dias dos reis de Israel e dos reis de Judá.
pt.B: Desde o tempo dos juízes que julgaram Israel, e durante todo o tempo dos reis de Israel e dos reis de Judá, nunca se tinha celebrado uma Páscoa como esta.
pt.R: Nenhuma Páscoa como esta tinha sido celebrada desde o tempo em que os juízes lideravam Israel, nem durante todos os anos em que os reis governaram Israel e Judá.

decisions.choice: like this Passover: in the way it was kept now
decisions.reason: The point is not that no Passover had been kept at all, but that none had been kept like this one: by the whole nation at the one place of worship, exactly as the book commanded. Hezekiah had kept a great Passover too, but some came to it unclean and it was held in the second month (2 Chronicles 30:2, 18).

decisions.choice: the judges who judged Israel: the leaders before the kings
decisions.reason: The judges were the leaders Yahweh raised up to rescue and govern Israel before there were kings (Judges 2:16). The phrase reaches back to the time after Joshua.

decisions.choice: 2 Chronicles 35:18: "since the days of Samuel the prophet"
decisions.reason: Chronicles says the same in other words: no Passover like it had been kept in Israel since the days of Samuel, the last of the judges.

decisions.choice: the judges who judged Israel (Literal, Balanced); judges led Israel (Readable)
decisions.reason: The wording kept for these words since Judges. Literal supplies "Passover" in brackets, since the Hebrew leaves it to be understood.

decisions.choice: waamuzi waliowaamua (Literal, Balanced); waamuzi waliwaongoza (Readable)
decisions.reason: The judges as settled in 1 Samuel: "waamuzi", with "kuamua" (Balanced) and "kuongoza" (Readable).

decisions.choice: "사사들" with "다스리다" (L, B), "이끌다" (R)
decisions.reason: The settled wording from Samuel: "사사" as the title, with the verb "다스리다" (L, B) and "이끌다" (R).

decisions.choice: quan xét (Literal, Balanced); thủ lĩnh (Readable)
decisions.reason: The judges of Israel: the word follows Joshua–Ruth: "quan xét" (Literal, Balanced), the name of the office in Judges and Acts 13:20, and "thủ lĩnh" (Readable); "thẩm phán" would suggest a law court.

source.text: כִּ֗י אִם־בִּשְׁמֹנֶ֤ה עֶשְׂרֵה֙ שָׁנָ֔ה לַמֶּ֖לֶךְ יֹֽאשִׁיָּ֑הוּ נַעֲשָׂ֞ה הַפֶּ֧סַח הַזֶּ֛ה לַיהוָ֖ה בִּירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: But in [the] eighteenth year of the king Josiah was kept the Passover the this to Yahweh in Jerusalem.

en.L: But in the eighteenth year of King Josiah this Passover was kept to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} in Jerusalem.
en.B: But this Passover was kept to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} in Jerusalem in the eighteenth year of King Josiah.
en.R: But in the eighteenth year that Josiah was king, this Passover was celebrated in Jerusalem to honor {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

es.L: Sino que en el año dieciocho del rey Josías se celebró esta Pascua {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} en Jerusalén.
es.B: Pero esta Pascua se celebró {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} en Jerusalén en el año dieciocho del rey Josías.
es.R: Pero en el año dieciocho del reinado de Josías, esta Pascua se celebró en Jerusalén en honor {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Mais en la dix-huitième année du roi Josias, cette Pâque fut célébrée pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} à Jérusalem.
fr.B: Mais c’est la dix-huitième année du roi Josias que cette Pâque fut célébrée en l’honneur {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} à Jérusalem.
fr.R: Mais la dix-huitième année du règne de Josias, cette Pâque a été célébrée à Jérusalem en l’honneur {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Lakini katika mwaka wa kumi na nane wa mfalme Yosia Pasaka hii ilifanywa kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} huko Yerusalemu.
sw.B: Lakini Pasaka hii ilishikwa kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} huko Yerusalemu katika mwaka wa kumi na nane wa mfalme Yosia.
sw.R: Lakini katika mwaka wa kumi na nane wa utawala wa Yosia, Pasaka hii ilisherehekewa huko Yerusalemu ili kumheshimu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

vi.L: Nhưng vào năm thứ mười tám đời vua Giô-si-a, Lễ Vượt Qua này được giữ cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} tại Giê-ru-sa-lem.
vi.B: Nhưng Lễ Vượt Qua này được giữ cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} tại Giê-ru-sa-lem vào năm thứ mười tám đời vua Giô-si-a.
vi.R: Nhưng vào năm thứ mười tám đời Giô-si-a làm vua, Lễ Vượt Qua này được cử hành tại Giê-ru-sa-lem để tôn vinh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.

ko.L: 그러나 요시야 왕의 제십팔년에 예루살렘에서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 이 유월절이 지켜졌다.
ko.B: 그러나 요시야 왕이 다스린 지 십팔 년째 되는 해에 예루살렘에서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 이 유월절을 지켰다.
ko.R: 그런데 요시야가 왕이 된 지 십팔 년째 되는 해에, 예루살렘에서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 영광을 돌리며 이 유월절을 지켰다.

pt.L: Mas no décimo oitavo ano do rei Josias esta Páscoa foi celebrada {{divine_name:para o SENHOR|para Javé}} em Jerusalém.
pt.B: Mas esta Páscoa foi celebrada {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}} em Jerusalém no décimo oitavo ano do rei Josias.
pt.R: Mas, no décimo oitavo ano do reinado de Josias, esta Páscoa foi celebrada em Jerusalém em honra {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}.

decisions.choice: the eighteenth year of Josiah: the year the book was found
decisions.reason: The book was found in the eighteenth year of Josiah (22:3), about 622 BC. The reform, the covenant and the Passover all came in the same year.

decisions.choice: but: in contrast with all the years before
decisions.reason: The words set this Passover against the long time of verse 22 when none like it had been kept.

decisions.choice: celebrated ... to honor
decisions.reason: As in verse 21.

source.text: וְגַ֣ם אֶת־הָאֹב֣וֹת וְאֶת־הַ֠יִּדְּעֹנִים וְאֶת־הַתְּרָפִ֨ים וְאֶת־הַגִּלֻּלִ֜ים וְאֵ֣ת כָּל־הַשִּׁקֻּצִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֤ר נִרְאוּ֙ בְּאֶ֤רֶץ יְהוּדָה֙ וּבִיר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם בִּעֵ֖ר יֹֽאשִׁיָּ֑הוּ לְ֠מַעַן הָקִ֞ים אֶת־דִּבְרֵ֤י הַתּוֹרָה֙ הַכְּתֻבִ֣ים עַל־הַסֵּ֔פֶר אֲשֶׁ֥ר מָצָ֛א חִלְקִיָּ֥הוּ הַכֹּהֵ֖ן בֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And also the mediums and the spiritists and the household gods and the idols and all the detestable things which were seen in [the] land of Judah and in Jerusalem, burned away Josiah, in order to establish [the] words of the law written on the book which found Hilkiah the priest [in the] house of Yahweh.

en.L: And also the mediums and the spiritists and the household gods and the idols and all the detestable things that were seen in the land of Judah and in Jerusalem, Josiah purged, in order to carry out the words of the law that were written in the book that Hilkiah the priest had found [in the] house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: Josiah also purged the mediums and the spiritists, the household gods, the idols and all the detestable things to be seen in the land of Judah and in Jerusalem. He did this so as to carry out the words of the law, as they were written in the book Hilkiah the priest had discovered in the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: Josiah also got rid of the people who said they could talk with the dead or with spirits. He got rid of the household idols, the other idols, and all the disgusting things people worshiped in Judah and Jerusalem. Josiah did this to obey the teaching written in the book that the priest Hilkiah had found in {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s temple.

es.L: Y también a los médiums, y a los espiritistas, y los dioses domésticos, y los ídolos y todas las abominaciones que se veían en la tierra de Judá y en Jerusalén, los barrió Josías, para cumplir las palabras de la ley que estaban escritas en el libro que el sacerdote Hilcías había hallado [en la] casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.B: Josías también eliminó a los médiums y a los espiritistas, los ídolos domésticos, los ídolos y todas las cosas detestables que se veían en la tierra de Judá y en Jerusalén. Lo hizo para cumplir las palabras de la ley, tal como estaban escritas en el libro que el sacerdote Hilcías había descubierto en la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.R: Josías también echó a los que decían que podían hablar con los muertos o con los espíritus. Eliminó los ídolos domésticos, los demás ídolos y todas las cosas repugnantes que la gente adoraba en Judá y en Jerusalén. Josías hizo esto para obedecer la enseñanza escrita en el libro que el sacerdote Hilcías había encontrado en el templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Et aussi les nécromanciens, les devins, les dieux domestiques, les idoles et toutes les horreurs qui se voyaient dans le pays de Juda et à Jérusalem, Josias les fit disparaître, afin d’accomplir les paroles de la Loi écrites dans le livre que le prêtre Hilqiya avait trouvé [dans] la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Josias élimina aussi les nécromanciens et les devins, les dieux domestiques, les idoles et toutes les horreurs qu’on voyait dans le pays de Juda et à Jérusalem. Il le fit pour accomplir les paroles de la Loi, telles qu’elles étaient écrites dans le livre que le prêtre Hilqiya avait découvert dans la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Josias a aussi chassé les gens qui prétendaient parler avec les morts ou avec les esprits. Il a fait disparaître les idoles domestiques, les autres idoles et toutes les choses dégoûtantes qu’on adorait en Juda et à Jérusalem. Josias a fait cela pour obéir à l’enseignement écrit dans le livre que le prêtre Hilqiya avait trouvé dans le temple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Na pia wenye pepo wa mizimu na wapiga ramli na vinyago vya nyumbani na sanamu na machukizo yote yaliyoonekana katika nchi ya Yuda na katika Yerusalemu, Yosia akayaondoa kabisa, ili kuyatimiza maneno ya Sheria yaliyoandikwa katika kitabu alichokiona Hilkia kuhani [katika] nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Yosia aliwaondoa kabisa pia wanaowaita wafu na wapiga ramli, vinyago vya nyumbani, sanamu, na machukizo yote yaliyoonekana katika nchi ya Yuda na katika Yerusalemu. Alifanya hivyo ili kuyatimiza maneno ya Sheria, kama yalivyoandikwa katika kitabu alichokipata Hilkia kuhani katika nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Yosia aliwaondoa pia watu waliodai kwamba wanaweza kuzungumza na wafu au na mizimu. Aliviondoa vinyago vya miungu ya nyumbani, sanamu nyingine, na mambo yote ya kuchukiza ambayo watu waliyaabudu katika Yuda na Yerusalemu. Yosia alifanya hivyo ili kutii mafundisho yaliyoandikwa katika kitabu ambacho kuhani Hilkia alikipata katika hekalu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

vi.L: Giô-si-a cũng diệt trừ đồng bóng, thầy đồng, các tượng thần gia đình, các thần tượng và mọi vật đáng ghê tởm thấy trong xứ Giu-đa và tại Giê-ru-sa-lem, để thực hiện những lời của luật pháp đã chép trong sách mà thầy tế lễ Hinh-kia đã tìm thấy [trong] nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.B: Giô-si-a cũng diệt trừ đồng bóng, thầy đồng, các tượng thần gia đình, các thần tượng và mọi vật ghê tởm thấy trong xứ Giu-đa và tại Giê-ru-sa-lem. Vua làm vậy để thực hiện những lời của luật pháp đã chép trong sách mà thầy tế lễ Hinh-kia đã tìm thấy trong nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.R: Giô-si-a cũng trừ bỏ những kẻ tự nhận có thể nói chuyện với người chết hay với các vong linh. Vua dẹp bỏ các tượng thần nhỏ của gia đình, các thần tượng khác, và mọi thứ ghê tởm người ta thờ tại Giu-đa và Giê-ru-sa-lem. Giô-si-a làm vậy để vâng theo lời dạy đã chép trong sách mà thầy tế lễ Hinh-kia đã tìm thấy trong đền thờ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.

ko.L: 그리고 혼백을 불러내는 자들과 영매들과 드라빔과 우상들과, 유다 땅과 예루살렘에 보이는 모든 가증한 것을 요시야가 없애 버렸다. 이는 제사장 힐기야가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집에서 발견한 책에 기록된 율법의 말씀을 이루려는 것이었다.
ko.B: 요시야는 또 혼백을 불러내는 자들과 영매들과 집안 우상들과 우상들과, 유다 땅과 예루살렘에 보이는 모든 가증한 것을 없애 버렸다. 그는 제사장 힐기야가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집에서 찾아낸 책에 기록된 율법의 말씀을 실행하려고 그렇게 했다.
ko.R: 요시야는 또 죽은 사람이나 영과 이야기할 수 있다는 사람들을 없앴다. 그는 집안 우상들과 다른 우상들과, 유다와 예루살렘에서 사람들이 섬기던 역겨운 것들을 모두 없앴다. 그는 제사장 힐기야가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 성전에서 찾은 책에 적힌 가르침을 지키려고 그렇게 했다.

pt.L: E também os médiuns, e os espíritas, e os ídolos do lar, e os ídolos, e todas as abominações que se viam na terra de Judá e em Jerusalém, Josias [os] eliminou, para cumprir as palavras da lei escritas no livro que Hilquias, o sacerdote, tinha achado [na] casa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}.
pt.B: Josias também eliminou os médiuns e os espíritas, os ídolos do lar, os ídolos e todas as coisas abomináveis que se viam na terra de Judá e em Jerusalém. Ele fez isso para cumprir as palavras da lei, como estavam escritas no livro que o sacerdote Hilquias tinha descoberto na casa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}.
pt.R: Josias também se livrou das pessoas que diziam falar com os mortos ou com os espíritos. Ele se livrou dos ídolos do lar, dos outros ídolos e de todas as coisas repugnantes que as pessoas adoravam em Judá e em Jerusalém. Josias fez isso para obedecer ao ensino escrito no livro que o sacerdote Hilquias tinha encontrado no templo {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}.

decisions.choice: mediums and spiritists: those who claimed to speak with the dead and with spirits
decisions.reason: The law forbids consulting them (Leviticus 19:31; Deuteronomy 18:11), and Manasseh had appointed them (21:6). The words may name the practitioners or the spirits and objects they used; either way, their practice is what Josiah ended.

decisions.choice: household gods: teraphim, images used in the home and for seeking omens
decisions.reason: Teraphim were small images kept in a household (Genesis 31:19) and sometimes used to ask for guidance (Ezekiel 21:26).

decisions.choice: idols, detestable things: scornful words for images of other gods
decisions.reason: The word for idols is used only with contempt and may come from a word for dung (1 Kings 15:12). "Detestable things" is the word used for Milcom in 1 Kings 11:5.

decisions.choice: purged: burned away, removed completely
decisions.reason: The verb means to burn, and so to clear away completely. It is used in Deuteronomy's command "you shall purge the evil from among you" (Deuteronomy 13:6; 17:7).

decisions.choice: the law: the instruction written in the book
decisions.reason: As in Deuteronomy, the word (torah) means instruction, the whole of what the book teaches, and not only rules (Deuteronomy 1:5).

decisions.choice: mediums, spiritists (Literal, Balanced); people who said they could talk with the dead or with spirits (Readable); household gods / household idols
decisions.reason: The wording used at 1 Samuel 28:3, and the wording kept for teraphim in these books. Readable says "teaching" for the law, as in Deuteronomy.

decisions.choice: "médiums", "espiritistas" (L, B); "los dioses domésticos" (L); "los ídolos domésticos" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The words used at 21:6, and the Samuel terms note's wording for teraphim at each level; Readable explains the mediums, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "les dieux domestiques" (L, B); "les idoles domestiques" (R)
decisions.reason: The household gods as the Samuel terms note sets them, one wording per level.

decisions.choice: vinyago vya nyumbani (Literal, Balanced); vinyago vya miungu ya nyumbani (Readable)
decisions.reason: The household gods (*teraphim*, meaning decision m2) as small images kept in the home.

decisions.choice: "드라빔" (L); "집안 우상" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Samuel note's wording for the household gods.

decisions.choice: os médiuns e os espíritas (L, B), as pessoas que diziam falar com os mortos ou com os espíritos (R); os ídolos do lar (every level)
decisions.reason: The practitioners (m1) keep the words 21:6, Deuteronomy 18:11 and 1 Samuel 28:3 give them in Portuguese; Readable says what they claimed, as the English does. The teraphim (m2) are "ídolos do lar", the words 1 Samuel 19:13 uses at every level, as the English Literal here says "household gods". "A lei" at Literal and Balanced and "o ensino" at Readable for torah (m5), as 22:8 sets it.

source.text: וְכָמֹהוּ֩ לֹֽא־הָיָ֨ה לְפָנָ֜יו מֶ֗לֶךְ אֲשֶׁר־שָׁ֤ב אֶל־יְהוָה֙ בְּכָל־לְבָב֤וֹ וּבְכָל־נַפְשׁוֹ֙ וּבְכָל־מְאֹד֔וֹ כְּכֹ֖ל תּוֹרַ֣ת מֹשֶׁ֑ה וְאַחֲרָ֖יו לֹֽא־קָ֥ם כָּמֹֽהוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And like him not was before him [a] king who turned to Yahweh with all his heart and with all his soul and with all his might, according to all [the] law of Moses; and after him not arose like him.

en.L: And before him there was no king like him, who turned to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} with all his heart and with all his soul and with all his power, according to all the law of Moses; and after him none like him arose.
en.B: Before him there was no king like him, who turned to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} with his whole heart, with his whole being, and with all his strength, in keeping with all the law of Moses; and after him no one like him arose.
en.R: There had never been a king like Josiah. He turned to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} with all his heart, with all his life, and with all his strength. He obeyed all the teaching of Moses. And no king like him ever came after him.

es.L: Y antes de él no hubo rey como él, que se volviera {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} con todo su corazón, y con toda su alma y con todas sus fuerzas, conforme a toda la ley de Moisés; y después de él no se levantó otro como él.
es.B: Antes de él no hubo ningún rey como él, que se volviera {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} con todo su corazón, con todo su ser y con todas sus fuerzas, conforme a toda la ley de Moisés; y después de él no surgió nadie como él.
es.R: Nunca hubo un rey como Josías. Se volvió {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} con todo su corazón, con toda su vida y con todas sus fuerzas. Obedeció toda la enseñanza de Moisés. Y después de él nunca hubo otro rey como él.

fr.L: Et avant lui il n’y eut pas de roi semblable à lui, qui revint {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} de tout son cœur, de toute son âme et de toute sa force, selon toute la loi de Moïse ; et après lui il ne s’en leva pas de semblable à lui.
fr.B: Avant lui, il n’y eut aucun roi semblable à lui, qui se tourna vers {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} de tout son cœur, de tout son être et de toute sa force, conformément à toute la loi de Moïse ; et après lui, il ne s’en leva aucun qui lui fût semblable.
fr.R: Il n’y avait jamais eu de roi comme Josias. Il s’est tourné vers {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} de tout son cœur, de toute sa vie et de toutes ses forces. Il a obéi à tout l’enseignement de Moïse. Et après lui, il n’y a jamais eu de roi comme lui.

sw.L: Na kabla yake hapakuwa na mfalme kama yeye, aliyemrudia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kwa moyo wake wote na kwa roho yake yote na kwa nguvu zake zote, sawasawa na Sheria yote ya Musa; wala baada yake hakuinuka mwingine kama yeye.
sw.B: Kabla yake hapakuwa na mfalme kama yeye, aliyemgeukia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kwa moyo wake wote, kwa nafsi yake yote, na kwa nguvu zake zote, kwa kufuata Sheria yote ya Musa; wala baada yake hakutokea mwingine kama yeye.
sw.R: Hapakuwa na mfalme mwingine kama Yosia. Alimgeukia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kwa moyo wake wote, kwa maisha yake yote, na kwa nguvu zake zote. Aliyatii mafundisho yote ya Musa. Wala hapakutokea mfalme mwingine kama yeye baada yake.

vi.L: Trước ông không có vua nào giống như ông, đã quay về cùng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} hết lòng, hết linh hồn và hết sức mình, theo mọi luật pháp của Môi-se; và sau ông không có ai giống như ông dấy lên.
vi.B: Trước ông chưa có vua nào giống như ông, quay về cùng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} với trọn cả tấm lòng, trọn cả con người và hết sức lực mình, đúng theo mọi luật pháp của Môi-se; và sau ông cũng không có ai như ông.
vi.R: Chưa từng có vua nào giống như Giô-si-a. Ông quay về cùng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} hết lòng, hết cả cuộc đời và hết sức mình. Ông vâng giữ mọi lời dạy của Môi-se. Và sau ông cũng không có vua nào giống như ông.

ko.L: 그리고 그보다 앞에는 모세의 모든 율법대로 온 마음과 온 목숨과 온 힘을 다하여 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 돌아온 그와 같은 왕이 없었고, 그 뒤에도 그와 같은 이가 일어나지 않았다.
ko.B: 그보다 앞서 그와 같은 왕이 없었다. 그는 모세의 모든 율법을 따라 온 마음과 온 목숨과 온 힘을 다하여 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 돌아왔다. 그 뒤에도 그와 같은 왕은 일어나지 않았다.
ko.R: 요시야와 같은 왕은 그 전에 한 번도 없었다. 그는 온 마음과 온 생명과 온 힘을 다하여 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 돌아왔다. 그는 모세의 모든 가르침에 순종했다. 그 뒤에도 그와 같은 왕은 다시 나오지 않았다.

pt.L: E antes dele não houve rei como ele, que se voltasse {{divine_name:para o SENHOR|para Javé}} com todo o seu coração, e com toda a sua alma, e com toda a sua força, conforme toda a lei de Moisés; e depois dele não se levantou [outro] como ele.
pt.B: Antes dele não houve nenhum rei como ele, que se voltasse {{divine_name:para o SENHOR|para Javé}} de todo o coração, de toda a alma e com todas as suas forças, conforme toda a lei de Moisés; e depois dele não surgiu ninguém como ele.
pt.R: Nunca tinha existido um rei como Josias. Ele se voltou {{divine_name:para o SENHOR|para Javé}} com todo o seu coração, com toda a sua vida e com todas as suas forças. Ele obedeceu a todo o ensino de Moisés. E nenhum rei depois dele foi como ele.

decisions.choice: with all his heart, soul and might: Deuteronomy 6:5
decisions.reason: These are the words of the command "you shall love Yahweh your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your strength" (Deuteronomy 6:5). This is the only other place where the three are found together. Josiah is the king who did what the law asks above everything.

decisions.choice: turned: returned to Yahweh
decisions.reason: The verb means to turn or return, and is used for turning back to Yahweh in repentance (Deuteronomy 30:2, 10; 1 Kings 8:48). Verse 26 uses the same verb: Josiah turned to Yahweh, but Yahweh did not turn from his anger.

decisions.choice: might, strength: everything one has and can do
decisions.reason: As in Deuteronomy 6:5, the word that usually means "very" is used as a noun for all one's power and means.

decisions.choice: none like him before or after: the highest praise
decisions.reason: Hezekiah too is praised as having no equal among the kings of Judah, for his trust in Yahweh (18:5). Josiah is praised for turning to Yahweh and keeping the whole law of Moses.

decisions.choice: with all his heart and with all his soul and with all his power / with his whole heart, with his whole being, and with all his strength / with all his heart, with all his life, and with all his strength
decisions.reason: Each level uses its own wording of Deuteronomy 6:5, so that the reader can hear the command behind the praise (m1).

decisions.choice: There had never been a king like Josiah
decisions.reason: Readable names the king and says first that he had no equal, then what he did. It says "teaching" for the law, as in Deuteronomy.

decisions.choice: "con todo su corazón, y con toda su alma y con todas sus fuerzas" (L); "con todo su ser" (B); "con toda su vida" (R)
decisions.reason: Each level keeps its own wording of Deuteronomy 6:5, following the English, so the command behind the praise is heard.

decisions.choice: "de tout son cœur, de toute son âme et de toute sa force" (L); "... de tout son être ..." (B); "... de toute sa vie et de toutes ses forces" (R)
decisions.reason: The words of Deuteronomy 6:5 (m1), kept as a triad at each level following the English.

decisions.choice: com todo o seu coração, e com toda a sua alma, e com toda a sua força (L); de todo o coração, de toda a alma e com todas as suas forças (B); com todo o seu coração, com toda a sua vida e com todas as suas forças (R)
decisions.reason: Each level keeps the words of Deuteronomy 6:5 in Portuguese (m1), and Balanced those of verse 3 for the covenant, so that the reader hears that Josiah did what the command asks. "Voltar-se para" says the turning back to the LORD (m2) that verse 26 answers with "não se desviou".

source.text: אַ֣ךְ׀לֹֽא־שָׁ֣ב יְהוָ֗ה מֵחֲר֤וֹן אַפּוֹ֙ הַגָּד֔וֹל אֲשֶׁר־חָרָ֥ה אַפּ֖וֹ בִּֽיהוּדָ֑ה עַ֚ל כָּל־הַכְּעָסִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר הִכְעִיס֖וֹ מְנַשֶּֽׁה׃

records.literal_gloss: Only not turned Yahweh from [the] burning of his anger the great, which burned his anger against Judah, because of all the provocations with which provoked him Manasseh.

en.L: Yet {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} did not turn from the burning of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} great anger, with which {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} anger burned against Judah because of all the provocations with which Manasseh had provoked {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.B: Even so, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} did not turn away from the fierceness of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} great anger, which burned against Judah because of all the ways Manasseh had provoked {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.R: Even so, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} did not turn away from {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} great anger against Judah. It still burned because of all that Manasseh had done to make {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} angry.

es.L: Con todo, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} no se apartó del ardor de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} gran ira, con que {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} ira se había encendido contra Judá por todas las provocaciones con que Manasés {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} había provocado.
es.B: Aun así, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} no se apartó del furor de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} gran ira, que ardía contra Judá por todas las maneras en que Manasés {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} había provocado.
es.R: Aun así, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} no dejó de estar muy enojado con Judá. Su ira seguía ardiendo por todo lo que Manasés había hecho para hacer{{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} enojar.

fr.L: Cependant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ne revint pas de l’ardeur de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} grande colère, dont {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} colère s’était enflammée contre Juda à cause de toutes les provocations par lesquelles Manassé {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}avait irrité.
fr.B: Malgré cela, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ne renonça pas à l’ardeur de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} grande colère, qui s’était enflammée contre Juda à cause de toutes les provocations par lesquelles Manassé {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}avait irrité.
fr.R: Malgré cela, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} n’a pas renoncé à {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} grande colère contre Juda. Elle brûlait toujours à cause de tout ce que Manassé avait fait pour {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} mettre en colère.

sw.L: Lakini {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} hakugeuka kuacha ukali wa hasira {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} kuu, ambayo hasira {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} iliwaka juu ya Yuda kwa sababu ya machokozi yote ambayo Manase alimchokoza nayo.
sw.B: Hata hivyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} hakugeuka kuacha ukali wa hasira {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} kuu, iliyowaka juu ya Yuda kwa sababu ya mambo yote ambayo Manase alimkasirisha nayo.
sw.R: Hata hivyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} hakuacha hasira {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} kuu juu ya Yuda. Bado iliwaka kwa sababu ya yote ambayo Manase alifanya ili kumkasirisha.

vi.L: Tuy nhiên, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} không nguôi cơn giận lớn nóng phừng của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, là cơn giận {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã nổi lên nghịch cùng Giu-đa vì mọi điều Ma-na-se đã làm chọc giận {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Dù vậy, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} vẫn không nguôi cơn thịnh nộ dữ dội của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, là cơn giận bừng cháy nghịch cùng Giu-đa vì mọi cách Ma-na-se đã chọc giận {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Dù vậy, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} vẫn không nguôi cơn giận lớn của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đối với Giu-đa. Cơn giận ấy vẫn bừng cháy vì mọi điều Ma-na-se đã làm để chọc giận {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 그러나 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 므낫세가 그분을 노엽게 한 모든 일 때문에 유다를 향하여 불타오른 그분의 큰 진노의 불길에서 돌이키지 않으셨다.
ko.B: 그런데도 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 유다를 향한 그분의 크고 맹렬한 진노를 거두지 않으셨다. 므낫세가 온갖 일로 그분을 노엽게 했기 때문이다.
ko.R: 그런데도 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 유다를 향한 큰 분노를 거두지 않으셨다. 므낫세가 그분을 화나시게 한 모든 일 때문에 그분의 분노가 여전히 불타고 있었다.

pt.L: Contudo, {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} não se desviou do ardor da {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} grande ira, com que a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} ira tinha se acendido contra Judá, por causa de todas as provocações com que Manassés {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} tinha provocado.
pt.B: Mesmo assim, {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} não desistiu do furor da {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} grande ira, que ardia contra Judá por causa de todas as coisas com que Manassés {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} tinha provocado.
pt.R: Mesmo assim, {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} não deixou de lado a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} grande ira contra Judá. Ela ainda queimava por causa de tudo o que Manassés tinha feito para {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} deixar irado.

decisions.choice: did not turn: the same verb as in verse 25
decisions.reason: Josiah "turned" to Yahweh with all his heart (verse 25), but Yahweh did not "turn" from his anger. The repeated verb sets the king's turning against the judgment that still stands.

decisions.choice: the provocations of Manasseh: 21:10-15
decisions.reason: Manasseh's sins had brought Yahweh's word that he would wipe Jerusalem as one wipes a dish (21:10-15). Huldah had told Josiah that the disaster would still come, though not in his days (22:16-20).

decisions.choice: the anger stands: one king's faithfulness does not undo the nation's long sin
decisions.reason: Kings does not say that Josiah's reform was in vain. It says that the judgment on Judah, earned over many reigns, was not taken back.

decisions.choice: the fierceness of his great anger
decisions.reason: The word means the burning or heat of anger. Balanced says "fierceness"; Literal keeps "burning".

decisions.choice: não se desviou (L); não desistiu (B); não deixou de lado (R)
decisions.reason: The verb is the same as Josiah's "turning" in verse 25 (m1), but Portuguese cannot use "voltar-se" for both without saying that the LORD turned toward his anger, so each level uses a verb of turning away from it; the meaning note gives the play on the word.

source.text: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר יְהוָ֗ה גַּ֤ם אֶת־יְהוּדָה֙ אָסִיר֙ מֵעַ֣ל פָּנַ֔י כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר הֲסִרֹ֖תִי אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וּ֠מָאַסְתִּי אֶת־הָעִ֨יר הַזֹּ֤את אֲשֶׁר־בָּחַ֨רְתִּי֙ אֶת־יְר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם וְאֶת־הַבַּ֔יִת אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָמַ֔רְתִּי יִהְיֶ֥ה שְׁמִ֖י שָֽׁם׃

records.literal_gloss: And said Yahweh, Also Judah I will remove from upon my face, as I removed Israel, and I will reject the city the this which I chose, Jerusalem, and the house which I said, My name will be there.

en.L: And {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} said, "Judah too I will remove from {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} sight, as I removed Israel, and I will reject this city that I chose, Jerusalem, and the house of which I said, 'My name will be there.'"
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} said, "I will remove Judah from {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} sight too, as I removed Israel. I will reject this city I chose, Jerusalem, and the house of which I said, 'My name will be there.'"
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} said, "I will send the people of Judah away from {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, just as I sent Israel away. I will reject Jerusalem, the city I chose, and the temple where I said {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} name would be."

es.L: Y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dijo: «También a Judá quitaré de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} presencia, como quité a Israel, y desecharé a esta ciudad que escogí, Jerusalén, y a la casa de la cual dije: ‘Mi nombre estará allí’».
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dijo: «También quitaré a Judá de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} presencia, como quité a Israel. Desecharé a esta ciudad que escogí, Jerusalén, y a la casa de la que dije: ‘Mi nombre estará allí’».
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dijo: «Echaré a la gente de Judá lejos de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}, igual que eché a Israel. Rechazaré a Jerusalén, la ciudad que escogí, y al templo donde dije que estaría {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} nombre».

fr.L: Et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dit : « Juda aussi, je l’ôterai de devant {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} face, comme j’ai ôté Israël, et je rejetterai cette ville que j’ai choisie, Jérusalem, et la maison dont j’ai dit : “Mon nom sera là.” »
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dit : « J’ôterai Juda aussi de devant {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} face, comme j’en ai ôté Israël. Je rejetterai cette ville que j’ai choisie, Jérusalem, et la maison dont j’ai dit : “Mon nom sera là.” »
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a dit : « Je renverrai le peuple de Juda loin de {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, comme j’ai renvoyé Israël. Je rejetterai Jérusalem, la ville que j’avais choisie, et le temple où j’avais dit que {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} nom serait. »

sw.L: Naye {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akasema, "Yuda nao nitawaondoa mbele ya uso {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, kama nilivyowaondoa Israeli, nami nitaukataa mji huu niliouchagua, Yerusalemu, na nyumba niliyosema habari zake, 'Jina langu litakuwa huko.'"
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alisema, "Nitawaondoa Yuda pia mbele {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}, kama nilivyowaondoa Israeli. Nitaukataa mji huu niliouchagua, Yerusalemu, na nyumba niliyosema habari zake, 'Jina langu litakuwa huko.'"
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alisema, "Nitawaondoa watu wa Yuda mbele {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}, kama nilivyowaondoa Israeli. Nitaukataa Yerusalemu, mji niliouchagua, na hekalu nililosema kwamba jina {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}} litakuwa huko."

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán: "Giu-đa, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} cũng sẽ dời khỏi trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, như {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã dời Y-sơ-ra-ên; và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ khước từ thành này mà {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã chọn, là Giê-ru-sa-lem, và nhà mà {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã phán: 'Danh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ ở đó.'"
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán: "Ta cũng sẽ dời Giu-đa khỏi trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, như {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã dời Y-sơ-ra-ên. Ta sẽ khước từ thành mà {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã chọn là Giê-ru-sa-lem, và nhà mà {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã phán: 'Danh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ ở đó.'"
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán: "Ta sẽ đuổi dân Giu-đa đi khỏi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, như {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã đuổi Y-sơ-ra-ên. Ta sẽ khước từ Giê-ru-sa-lem, là thành {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã chọn, và khước từ đền thờ nơi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã phán rằng danh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ ở đó."

ko.L: 그리고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 말씀하셨다. "내가 이스라엘을 없애 버린 것처럼 유다도 내 앞에서 없애 버리겠다. 그리고 내가 택한 이 성 예루살렘과 '내 이름이 거기에 있을 것이다' 하고 내가 말한 집을 내가 버리겠다."
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 말씀하셨다. "내가 이스라엘을 내 앞에서 없애 버렸듯이 유다도 없애 버리겠다. 내가 택한 이 성 예루살렘과, '내 이름이 거기에 있을 것이다' 하고 말한 이 성전을 내가 버리겠다."
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 말씀하셨다. "내가 이스라엘을 쫓아 보냈듯이 유다 백성도 내 앞에서 쫓아 보내겠다. 내가 택한 성 예루살렘과, 내 이름을 두겠다고 말한 성전을 내가 버리겠다."

pt.L: E {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} disse: "Também Judá removerei de diante da {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} face, como removi Israel, e rejeitarei esta cidade que escolhi, Jerusalém, e a casa da qual eu disse: 'O {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} nome estará ali.'"
pt.B: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} disse: "Também removerei Judá da {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} presença, como removi Israel. Rejeitarei esta cidade que escolhi, Jerusalém, e a casa da qual eu disse: 'O {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} nome estará ali.'"
pt.R: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} disse: "Vou mandar o povo de Judá para longe de {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}}, como mandei Israel para longe. Vou rejeitar Jerusalém, a cidade que escolhi, e o templo onde eu disse que o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} nome estaria."

decisions.choice: remove Judah as I removed Israel: 17:18-23
decisions.reason: Yahweh had removed Israel from his sight and sent it into exile in Assyria (17:18, 23). Judah will go the same way (21:13).

decisions.choice: my name will be there: the temple as the place Yahweh claimed as his own
decisions.reason: Yahweh's name stands for his presence and his claim of ownership. He had said that his name would be in the temple (1 Kings 8:29; 9:3; Deuteronomy 12:5). Even the chosen city and its temple will not be spared.

decisions.choice: Yahweh said: his word through the prophets
decisions.reason: The verse does not say when or to whom Yahweh said this. It sums up his word spoken through the prophets in Manasseh's time (21:10-15).

decisions.choice: send the people of Judah away from me; the temple
decisions.reason: Readable says what "remove from my sight" meant: exile. "The house" is the temple.

decisions.choice: 'Jina langu' plain at the start of the quotation
decisions.reason: "My" at the start of a quoted sentence is written plainly with its capital, as the style guide asks; Readable, where it falls inside the sentence, takes the span.

source.text: וְיֶ֛תֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י יֹאשִׁיָּ֖הוּ וְכָל־אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֑ה הֲלֹא־הֵ֣ם כְּתוּבִ֗ים עַל־סֵ֛פֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י הַיָּמִ֖ים לְמַלְכֵ֥י יְהוּדָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And [the] rest of [the] matters of Josiah and all that he did, [are] not they written on [the] book of [the] matters of the days of [the] kings of Judah?

en.L: And the rest of the matters of Josiah and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the matters of the days of the kings of Judah?
en.B: The rest of the acts of Josiah, and all that he did, are written in the Book of the History of the Kings of Judah.
en.R: Everything else Josiah did is written in the history of the kings of Judah.

es.L: Y los demás hechos de Josías, y todo lo que hizo, ¿no están escritos en el libro de los hechos de los días de los reyes de Judá?
es.B: Los demás hechos de Josías, y todo lo que hizo, están escritos en el libro de la Historia de los Reyes de Judá.
es.R: Todo lo demás que hizo Josías está escrito en la historia de los reyes de Judá.

fr.L: Et le reste des actes de Josias et tout ce qu’il fit, n’est-il pas écrit dans le livre des Annales des rois de Juda ?
fr.B: Le reste des actes de Josias et tout ce qu’il fit est écrit dans le livre des Annales des rois de Juda.
fr.R: Tout le reste de ce qu’a fait Josias a été écrit dans le livre des Annales des rois de Juda.

sw.L: Na mambo mengine ya Yosia, na yote aliyoyafanya, je, hayajaandikwa katika kitabu cha mambo ya siku za wafalme wa Yuda?
sw.B: Mambo mengine ya Yosia, na yote aliyoyafanya, yameandikwa katika Kitabu cha Historia ya Wafalme wa Yuda.
sw.R: Mambo mengine yote aliyoyafanya Yosia yameandikwa katika historia ya wafalme wa Yuda.

vi.L: Các việc khác của Giô-si-a và mọi điều ông đã làm, chẳng phải đã được chép trong sách ghi chép các việc thời các vua Giu-đa sao?
vi.B: Các việc khác của Giô-si-a và mọi điều ông đã làm đều được chép trong Sách Lịch Sử Các Vua Giu-đa.
vi.R: Mọi việc khác Giô-si-a đã làm đều được chép trong sách lịch sử các vua Giu-đa.

ko.L: 그리고 요시야의 나머지 일들과 그가 한 모든 것은 유다 왕들의 날들의 일을 적은 책에 기록되어 있지 않으냐?
ko.B: 요시야의 나머지 행적과 그가 한 모든 일은 유다 왕 실록에 기록되어 있다.
ko.R: 요시야가 한 나머지 일은 유다 왕들의 역사를 적은 책에 기록되어 있다.

pt.L: E o restante dos atos de Josias e tudo o que ele fez, não estão escritos no livro das crônicas dos reis de Judá?
pt.B: Os demais atos de Josias e tudo o que ele fez estão escritos no Livro das Crônicas dos Reis de Judá.
pt.R: Tudo o mais que Josias fez está escrito na história dos reis de Judá.

decisions.choice: the book of the matters of the days of the kings of Judah: a royal record the writer could consult
decisions.reason: As elsewhere in Kings (12:20; 1 Kings 15:7), the writer sends the reader to a fuller written record of Judah's kings, now lost. The question "are they not written ...?" means "they are written".

decisions.choice: a statement in place of the question
decisions.reason: As in the sources formula throughout these books, Balanced and Readable state as a fact what the Hebrew asks as a question; Literal keeps the question.

decisions.choice: "el libro de los hechos de los días de los reyes de Judá" (L); "el libro de la Historia de los Reyes de Judá" (B); "la historia de los reyes de Judá" (R)
alternatives: el libro de las Crónicas de los reyes de Judá
decisions.reason: The source formula keeps one wording at each level through Kings, as the terms note sets it, and avoids "Crónicas", the Spanish title of the book of Chronicles.

decisions.choice: o restante dos atos de ... (L); Os demais atos de ... (B); Tudo o mais que ... fez (R)
decisions.reason: The source note keeps the wording 1 Kings 14:29 and 2 Kings 1:18 set for the book at each level: a question at Literal, a statement at Balanced and Readable (m1).

source.text: בְּיָמָ֡יו עָלָה֩ פַרְעֹ֨ה נְכֹ֧ה מֶֽלֶךְ־מִצְרַ֛יִם עַל־מֶ֥לֶךְ אַשּׁ֖וּר עַל־נְהַר־פְּרָ֑ת וַיֵּ֨לֶךְ הַמֶּ֤לֶךְ יֹאשִׁיָּ֨הוּ֙ לִקְרָאת֔וֹ וַיְמִיתֵ֨הוּ֙ בִּמְגִדּ֔וֹ כִּרְאֹת֖וֹ אֹתֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: In his days went up Pharaoh Neco king of Egypt to [the] king of Assyria to [the] river Euphrates; and went the king Josiah to meet him, and he killed him at Megiddo when he saw him.

en.L: In his days Pharaoh Neco king of Egypt went up to the king of Assyria, to the river Euphrates. And King Josiah went to meet him, and [Neco] killed him at Megiddo when he saw him.
en.B: In his days Pharaoh Neco king of Egypt went up to the king of Assyria at the Euphrates River, and King Josiah marched out to meet him. When Neco saw him, he killed him at Megiddo.
en.R: While Josiah was king, Pharaoh Neco king of Egypt marched north to the Euphrates River to help the king of Assyria. King Josiah went out to face Neco. But as soon as Neco saw him at Megiddo, he killed him.

es.L: En sus días, el faraón Necao, rey de Egipto, subió al rey de Asiria, al río Éufrates. Y el rey Josías salió a su encuentro, y [Necao] lo mató en Meguido en cuanto lo vio.
es.B: En sus días, el faraón Necao, rey de Egipto, subió hacia el rey de Asiria, junto al río Éufrates, y el rey Josías salió a su encuentro. Cuando Necao lo vio, lo mató en Meguido.
es.R: Mientras Josías era rey, el faraón Necao, rey de Egipto, marchó hacia el norte, hasta el río Éufrates, para ayudar al rey de Asiria. El rey Josías salió a hacerle frente. Pero en cuanto Necao lo vio en Meguido, lo mató.

fr.L: En ses jours, le pharaon Néko, roi d’Égypte, monta vers le roi d’Assyrie, vers le fleuve de l’Euphrate. Et le roi Josias alla à sa rencontre, et [Néko] le tua à Meguiddo dès qu’il le vit.
fr.B: De son temps, le pharaon Néko, roi d’Égypte, monta vers le roi d’Assyrie, sur l’Euphrate, et le roi Josias marcha à sa rencontre. Dès que Néko le vit, il le tua à Meguiddo.
fr.R: Pendant que Josias était roi, le pharaon Néko, roi d’Égypte, est parti vers le nord, jusqu’à l’Euphrate, pour aider le roi d’Assyrie. Le roi Josias est allé affronter Néko. Mais dès que Néko l’a vu à Meguiddo, il l’a tué.

sw.L: Katika siku zake Farao Neko mfalme wa Misri alipanda kwa mfalme wa Ashuru, hata mto Frati. Naye mfalme Yosia akaenda kumlaki, naye [Neko] akamwua huko Megido alipomwona.
sw.B: Katika siku zake Farao Neko mfalme wa Misri alipanda kwenda kwa mfalme wa Ashuru kwenye mto Frati, naye mfalme Yosia akatoka kwenda kumkabili. Neko alipomwona, akamwua huko Megido.
sw.R: Yosia alipokuwa mfalme, Farao Neko mfalme wa Misri alikwenda kaskazini mpaka mto Frati ili kumsaidia mfalme wa Ashuru. Mfalme Yosia akatoka kwenda kupambana na Neko. Lakini mara Neko alipomwona huko Megido, akamwua.

vi.L: Trong đời ông, Pha-ra-ôn Nê-cô vua Ai Cập đi lên đến vua A-si-ri, đến sông Ơ-phơ-rát. Vua Giô-si-a đi ra đón đánh hắn, và [Nê-cô] giết vua tại Mê-ghi-đô khi thấy vua.
vi.B: Trong đời Giô-si-a, Pha-ra-ôn Nê-cô vua Ai Cập kéo lên đến vua A-si-ri ở sông Ơ-phơ-rát, và vua Giô-si-a kéo quân ra đón đánh. Khi Nê-cô thấy vua, hắn giết vua tại Mê-ghi-đô.
vi.R: Khi Giô-si-a đang làm vua, Pha-ra-ôn Nê-cô vua Ai Cập kéo quân lên phía bắc đến sông Ơ-phơ-rát để giúp vua A-si-ri. Vua Giô-si-a kéo quân ra chặn đánh Nê-cô. Nhưng vừa thấy Giô-si-a tại Mê-ghi-đô, Nê-cô liền giết vua.

ko.L: 그의 날들에 이집트 왕 바로 느고가 앗시리아 왕에게로 유프라테스 강까지 올라갔다. 그리고 요시야 왕이 그를 맞으러 갔는데, [느고가] 그를 보자 므깃도에서 그를 죽였다.
ko.B: 요시야가 다스리던 때에 이집트 왕 바로 느고가 앗시리아 왕을 도우러 유프라테스 강으로 올라갔다. 요시야 왕이 그를 맞서러 나가자, 느고는 므깃도에서 요시야를 보자마자 그를 죽였다.
ko.R: 요시야가 왕으로 있을 때, 이집트 왕 바로 느고가 앗시리아 왕을 도우려고 북쪽 유프라테스 강으로 올라갔다. 요시야 왕은 느고와 맞서 싸우려고 나갔다. 그러나 느고는 므깃도에서 요시야를 보자마자 그를 죽였다.

pt.L: Nos seus dias, Faraó Neco, rei do Egito, subiu ao rei da Assíria, ao rio Eufrates. E o rei Josias foi ao encontro dele, e [Neco] o matou em Megido, quando o viu.
pt.B: Nos dias de Josias, Faraó Neco, rei do Egito, subiu para se juntar ao rei da Assíria junto ao rio Eufrates, e o rei Josias saiu para enfrentá-lo. Quando Neco o viu, matou-o em Megido.
pt.R: No tempo em que Josias era rei, Faraó Neco, rei do Egito, marchou para o norte, até o rio Eufrates, para ajudar o rei da Assíria. O rei Josias saiu para enfrentar Neco. Mas, assim que Neco o viu em Megido, ele o matou.

decisions.choice: to the king of Assyria: to help him
decisions.reason: The word can mean "to" or "against". Records from the time show that in 609 BC Egypt marched north to support what was left of Assyria against the rising power of Babylon, so Neco went up to join the king of Assyria, not to fight him.

decisions.choice: went to meet him: went out to confront him
decisions.reason: To go "to meet" a king on the march can mean to go out against him. 2 Chronicles 35:20-24 tells of a battle in which Josiah was wounded by archers and died after being taken back to Jerusalem.

decisions.choice: when he saw him: at their first meeting
decisions.reason: The words stress how quickly it ended: as soon as Neco met Josiah, he killed him.

decisions.choice: Megiddo: a fortress guarding the main pass into the Jezreel Valley
decisions.reason: Megiddo controlled the road from the coast to the north, the way an army from Egypt had to take to reach Syria and the Euphrates.

decisions.choice: Pharaoh Neco: Neco II, king of Egypt
decisions.reason: "Pharaoh" is the Egyptian king's title, and Neco his name. He ruled Egypt from about 610 to 595 BC.

decisions.choice: marched north ... to help the king of Assyria; to face Neco
decisions.reason: Readable follows m1 and m2, saying why Neco marched and what Josiah went out to do.

decisions.choice: "el faraón Necao", "Meguido", "el río Éufrates"
decisions.reason: "El faraón Necao" and "Meguido" as the terms note's table gives them.

decisions.choice: "le pharaon Néko"; Meguiddo
decisions.reason: The forms of the terms note; "le pharaon" takes the article, as the French Pentateuch note sets.

decisions.choice: "앗시리아 왕을 도우러"
decisions.reason: Korean must choose a verb for "to the king of Assyria"; following meaning decision m1, Neco went up to help Assyria. Literal keeps the bare "앗시리아 왕에게로".

decisions.choice: Faraó Neco (no article); Megido; subiu ao rei da Assíria (L), subiu para se juntar ao rei da Assíria (B), para ajudar (R)
decisions.reason: For the whole book: "Faraó" takes no article where it stands as a title before the name (m5), as the Old Testament terms set it, and "Neco" is the usual Brazilian form; "Megido" as 9:27 sets it (m4). Balanced says "para se juntar" where the English "went up to" leaves it open, so as not to suggest an attack (m1); Literal keeps "subiu ao".

source.text: וַיַּרְכִּבֻ֨הוּ עֲבָדָ֥יו מֵת֙ מִמְּגִדּ֔וֹ וַיְבִאֻ֨הוּ֙ יְר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם וַֽיִּקְבְּרֻ֖הוּ בִּקְבֻֽרָת֑וֹ וַיִּקַּ֣ח עַם־הָאָ֗רֶץ אֶת־יְהֽוֹאָחָז֙ בֶּן־יֹ֣אשִׁיָּ֔הוּ וַיִּמְשְׁח֥וּ אֹת֛וֹ וַיַּמְלִ֥יכוּ אֹת֖וֹ תַּ֥חַת אָבִֽיו׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And made him ride his servants dead from Megiddo, and brought him [to] Jerusalem and buried him in his grave; and took [the] people of the land Jehoahaz son of Josiah, and anointed him and made him king in place of his father.

en.L: And his servants carried him dead [in a chariot] from Megiddo and brought him [to] Jerusalem and buried him in his own tomb. And the people of the land took Jehoahaz son of Josiah and anointed him and made him king in place of his father.
en.B: His officials carried his body in a chariot from Megiddo and brought him to Jerusalem, where they buried him in his own tomb. The people of the land then took Jehoahaz son of Josiah; they anointed him and made him king in place of his father.
en.R: His officials put his body in a chariot and brought it from Megiddo to Jerusalem. They buried him in the tomb that was his own. After that, the people of the land chose Josiah's son Jehoahaz. They anointed him and made him king in his father's place.

es.L: Y sus siervos lo llevaron muerto [en un carro] desde Meguido, y lo trajeron [a] Jerusalén y lo sepultaron en su sepulcro. Y el pueblo de la tierra tomó a Joacaz hijo de Josías, y lo ungieron y lo hicieron rey en lugar de su padre.
es.B: Sus funcionarios llevaron su cuerpo en un carro desde Meguido hasta Jerusalén, y allí lo sepultaron en su propio sepulcro. Entonces el pueblo de la tierra tomó a Joacaz hijo de Josías, lo ungieron y lo hicieron rey en lugar de su padre.
es.R: Sus funcionarios pusieron su cuerpo en un carro y lo llevaron de Meguido a Jerusalén. Lo sepultaron en su propio sepulcro. Después, el pueblo de la tierra escogió a Joacaz, el hijo de Josías. Lo ungieron y lo hicieron rey en lugar de su padre.

fr.L: Et ses serviteurs le transportèrent mort [en char] de Meguiddo, l’amenèrent [à] Jérusalem et l’enterrèrent dans son tombeau. Et le peuple du pays prit Joachaz fils de Josias, et ils l’oignirent et le firent roi à la place de son père.
fr.B: Ses officiers ramenèrent son corps en char de Meguiddo à Jérusalem, et ils l’enterrèrent dans son propre tombeau. Le peuple du pays prit alors Joachaz, fils de Josias ; ils l’oignirent et le firent roi à la place de son père.
fr.R: Ses officiers ont mis son corps dans un char et l’ont ramené de Meguiddo à Jérusalem. Ils l’ont enterré dans son propre tombeau. Ensuite, le peuple du pays a choisi Joachaz, le fils de Josias. Ils lui ont versé de l’huile sur la tête et l’ont fait roi à la place de son père.

sw.L: Nao watumishi wake wakampandisha [garini] akiwa amekufa kutoka Megido, wakamleta [hata] Yerusalemu, wakamzika katika kaburi lake. Nao watu wa nchi wakamchukua Yehoahazi mwana wa Yosia, wakampaka mafuta, wakamtawaza kuwa mfalme mahali pa baba yake.
sw.B: Maafisa wake waliubeba mwili wake garini kutoka Megido, wakauleta Yerusalemu, wakamzika katika kaburi lake mwenyewe. Kisha watu wa nchi wakamchukua Yehoahazi mwana wa Yosia, wakampaka mafuta na kumtawaza kuwa mfalme mahali pa baba yake.
sw.R: Maafisa wake waliuweka mwili wake katika gari la vita, wakauleta kutoka Megido mpaka Yerusalemu. Wakamzika katika kaburi lake mwenyewe. Baada ya hayo watu wa nchi walimchagua Yehoahazi, mwana wa Yosia. Wakampaka mafuta, wakamfanya kuwa mfalme mahali pa baba yake.

vi.L: Các đầy tớ vua chở vua đã chết [trên xe] từ Mê-ghi-đô, đem vua về Giê-ru-sa-lem và chôn vua trong mộ của vua. Dân trong xứ lấy Giô-a-cha con trai Giô-si-a, xức dầu cho ông và lập ông làm vua thay cha mình.
vi.B: Các triều thần chở thi hài vua trên xe từ Mê-ghi-đô về Giê-ru-sa-lem và chôn vua trong mộ của vua. Dân trong xứ bèn lập Giô-a-cha con trai Giô-si-a, xức dầu cho ông và tôn ông làm vua thay cha.
vi.R: Các quan chức đặt thi hài vua trên xe và đưa từ Mê-ghi-đô về Giê-ru-sa-lem. Họ chôn vua trong mộ riêng của vua. Sau đó dân trong xứ chọn Giô-a-cha con trai Giô-si-a. Họ xức dầu cho ông và lập ông làm vua thay cha mình.

ko.L: 그리고 그의 신하들이 죽은 그를 므깃도에서 [병거에] 태워 예루살렘으로 데려와, 그의 무덤에 그를 묻었다. 그리고 그 땅의 백성이 요시야의 아들 여호아하스를 데려다가 그에게 기름을 붓고 그의 아버지를 대신하여 그를 왕으로 삼았다.
ko.B: 그의 신하들은 그의 시신을 병거에 싣고 므깃도에서 예루살렘으로 옮겨 와서 그의 무덤에 장사했다. 그 땅의 백성은 요시야의 아들 여호아하스를 데려다가 그에게 기름을 부어 그의 아버지의 뒤를 이어 왕으로 세웠다.
ko.R: 그의 신하들은 그의 시신을 병거에 싣고 므깃도에서 예루살렘으로 옮겨 왔다. 그들은 그를 그의 무덤에 묻었다. 그 뒤에 그 땅의 백성은 요시야의 아들 여호아하스를 골랐다. 그들은 그에게 기름을 부어 그의 아버지의 뒤를 이어 왕으로 세웠다.

pt.L: E os seus servos o levaram morto [num carro] de Megido, e o trouxeram [a] Jerusalém e o sepultaram no seu sepulcro. E o povo da terra tomou Jeoacaz, filho de Josias, e o ungiram e o fizeram rei em lugar do seu pai.
pt.B: Os seus oficiais levaram o corpo dele num carro de Megido para Jerusalém e o sepultaram no seu próprio túmulo. Então o povo da terra tomou Jeoacaz, filho de Josias. Eles o ungiram e o fizeram rei no lugar do seu pai.
pt.R: Os seus oficiais puseram o corpo dele num carro e o levaram de Megido para Jerusalém. Eles o sepultaram no túmulo que era dele. Depois disso, o povo da terra escolheu Jeoacaz, filho de Josias. Eles o ungiram e o fizeram rei no lugar do seu pai.

decisions.choice: made him ride: carried him in a chariot
decisions.reason: The verb means to make someone ride, here in a chariot. 2 Chronicles 35:24 says his servants took him out of his chariot and put him in his second chariot.

decisions.choice: his servants: the king's officials
decisions.reason: The king's servants are the men of his court and army.

decisions.choice: the people of the land: the citizens of Judah
decisions.reason: As in 11:14 and 21:24, the free people of Judah as a body act to put a king on the throne. They chose Jehoahaz over his older brother Eliakim (verses 31, 36).

decisions.choice: anointed him: made him king with oil
decisions.reason: Pouring oil on the head set a man apart as king (1 Kings 1:39; 2 Kings 11:12).

decisions.choice: servants (Literal); officials (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: The wording kept for the king's servants in these books.

decisions.choice: "Joacaz"
decisions.reason: The name the verse uses, as the terms note sets ("Joacaz / Salum"); the other name of this king is Salum (m1 at verse 31).

decisions.choice: "oignirent" (L, B); "lui ont versé de l'huile sur la tête" (R)
decisions.reason: "Oindre" as the Samuel terms note sets; Readable describes the rite as the Samuel Readable does.

decisions.choice: Giô-a-cha (Jehoahaz son of Josiah)
decisions.reason: The king keeps the form this verse uses, Giô-a-cha, the same as Jehoahaz son of Jehu in chapter 13; Sa-lum is kept for the verses that call him Shallum.

decisions.choice: num carro; o povo da terra (every level); Jeoacaz
decisions.reason: The chariot (m1) is "carro", the book's word (2:11), bracketed at Literal as the English brackets it. "O povo da terra" as 21:24 keeps it at every level (m3). "Jeoacaz" is the form the shared list for Kings gives both kings of this name (13:1).

source.text: בֶּן־עֶשְׂרִ֨ים וְשָׁלֹ֤שׁ שָׁנָה֙ יְהוֹאָחָ֣ז בְּמָלְכ֔וֹ וּשְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה חֳדָשִׁ֔ים מָלַ֖ךְ בִּירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְשֵׁ֣ם אִמּ֔וֹ חֲמוּטַ֥ל בַּֽת־יִרְמְיָ֖הוּ מִלִּבְנָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: [A] son of twenty and three year[s] [was] Jehoahaz when he became king, and three months he reigned in Jerusalem; and [the] name of his mother [was] Hamutal daughter of Jeremiah from Libnah.

en.L: A son of twenty-three years [was] Jehoahaz when he became king, and three months he reigned in Jerusalem; and the name of his mother [was] Hamutal daughter of Jeremiah from Libnah.
en.B: Jehoahaz was twenty-three years old when he became king, and he reigned three months in Jerusalem. His mother's name was Hamutal daughter of Jeremiah from Libnah.
en.R: Jehoahaz was twenty-three years old when he became king. He ruled in Jerusalem for three months. His mother was Hamutal, the daughter of Jeremiah from Libnah.

es.L: Hijo de veintitrés años [era] Joacaz cuando comenzó a reinar, y tres meses reinó en Jerusalén; y el nombre de su madre [era] Hamutal hija de Jeremías, de Libna.
es.B: Joacaz tenía veintitrés años cuando comenzó a reinar, y reinó tres meses en Jerusalén. Su madre se llamaba Hamutal hija de Jeremías, de Libna.
es.R: Joacaz tenía veintitrés años cuando llegó a ser rey. Gobernó en Jerusalén durante tres meses. Su madre se llamaba Hamutal y era hija de Jeremías, de Libna.

fr.L: Joachaz avait vingt-trois ans quand il devint roi, et il régna trois mois à Jérusalem ; et le nom de sa mère [était] Hamoutal fille de Jérémie, de Libna.
fr.B: Joachaz avait vingt-trois ans quand il devint roi, et il régna trois mois à Jérusalem. Sa mère s’appelait Hamoutal, fille de Jérémie, de Libna.
fr.R: Joachaz avait vingt-trois ans quand il est devenu roi, et il a régné à Jérusalem pendant trois mois. Sa mère s’appelait Hamoutal ; c’était la fille de Jérémie, de Libna.

sw.L: Yehoahazi [alikuwa] mwana wa miaka ishirini na mitatu alipoanza kutawala, na miezi mitatu alitawala huko Yerusalemu; na jina la mama yake [lilikuwa] Hamutali binti Yeremia wa Libna.
sw.B: Yehoahazi alikuwa na umri wa miaka ishirini na mitatu alipoanza kutawala, naye akatawala miezi mitatu huko Yerusalemu. Mama yake aliitwa Hamutali binti Yeremia wa Libna.
sw.R: Yehoahazi alikuwa na umri wa miaka ishirini na mitatu alipoanza kutawala. Alitawala huko Yerusalemu kwa miezi mitatu. Mama yake aliitwa Hamutali binti Yeremia wa Libna.

vi.L: Giô-a-cha [được] hai mươi ba tuổi khi lên làm vua, và trị vì ba tháng tại Giê-ru-sa-lem. Tên mẹ ông [là] Ha-mu-tanh con gái Giê-rê-mi, người Líp-na.
vi.B: Giô-a-cha được hai mươi ba tuổi khi lên làm vua và trị vì ba tháng tại Giê-ru-sa-lem. Mẹ vua tên là Ha-mu-tanh con gái Giê-rê-mi, người Líp-na.
vi.R: Giô-a-cha được hai mươi ba tuổi khi lên làm vua. Ông cai trị tại Giê-ru-sa-lem ba tháng. Mẹ vua tên là Ha-mu-tanh, con gái Giê-rê-mi, người Líp-na.

ko.L: 여호아하스가 왕이 되었을 때 이십삼 세[였고], 예루살렘에서 석 달 동안 다스렸다. 그리고 그의 어머니의 이름은 립나 출신 예레미야의 딸 하무달이었다.
ko.B: 여호아하스는 이십삼 세에 왕이 되어 예루살렘에서 석 달 동안 다스렸다. 그의 어머니의 이름은 립나 출신 예레미야의 딸 하무달이었다.
ko.R: 여호아하스는 스물세 살에 왕이 되었다. 그는 예루살렘에서 석 달 동안 다스렸다. 그의 어머니는 립나 출신 예레미야의 딸 하무달이었다.

pt.L: Jeoacaz [tinha] vinte e três anos quando começou a reinar, e três meses reinou em Jerusalém; e o nome da sua mãe [era] Hamutal, filha de Jeremias, de Libna.
pt.B: Jeoacaz tinha vinte e três anos quando começou a reinar, e reinou três meses em Jerusalém. A sua mãe se chamava Hamutal, filha de Jeremias, de Libna.
pt.R: Jeoacaz tinha vinte e três anos quando se tornou rei. Ele governou em Jerusalém durante três meses. A mãe dele era Hamutal, filha de Jeremias, de Libna.

decisions.choice: Jehoahaz: also called Shallum
decisions.reason: Jeremiah 22:11 and 1 Chronicles 3:15 call this son of Josiah Shallum. Jehoahaz, "Yahweh has grasped", may have been the name he took as king. Kings uses Jehoahaz throughout.

decisions.choice: Jeremiah from Libnah: not the prophet
decisions.reason: This Jeremiah was from Libnah, a town in the lowland of Judah (8:22; 19:8). The prophet Jeremiah came from Anathoth (Jeremiah 1:1). Hamutal was also the mother of Zedekiah (24:18), so Jehoahaz and Zedekiah were full brothers.

decisions.choice: a son of twenty-three years: twenty-three years old
decisions.reason: Hebrew gives a person's age as being the son of so many years (12:1).

decisions.choice: Jehoahaz was twenty-three years old when he became king
decisions.reason: The accession formula is worded as throughout these books. Readable splits it into short sentences.

decisions.choice: Joachaz
decisions.reason: This king of Judah is Jehoahaz here and Shallum elsewhere (m1); French keeps the form the verse uses, Joachaz, as the terms note sets.

decisions.choice: Hamutal, filha de Jeremias, de Libna
decisions.reason: "Jeremias" is the same name as the prophet's in Portuguese, as the Hebrew has it (m2); the meaning note says he is a different man. "Libna" as Joshua 10:29 in Portuguese.

source.text: וַיַּ֥עַשׂ הָרַ֖ע בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה כְּכֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־עָשׂ֖וּ אֲבֹתָֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: And he did the evil in [the] eyes of Yahweh, according to all that had done his fathers.

en.L: And he did the evil in [the] eyes of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, according to all that his fathers had done.
en.B: He did what was evil in the sight of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, just as his ancestors had done.
en.R: He did what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} said was evil, just as his ancestors had done.

es.L: E hizo lo malo a los ojos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, conforme a todo lo que habían hecho sus padres.
es.B: Hizo lo malo a los ojos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, tal como lo habían hecho sus antepasados.
es.R: Hizo lo que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} reprueba, tal como lo habían hecho sus antepasados.

fr.L: Et il fit ce qui est mal aux yeux {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, selon tout ce qu’avaient fait ses pères.
fr.B: Il fit ce qui est mal aux yeux {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, tout comme ses ancêtres.
fr.R: Il a fait ce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} déclare mauvais, comme ses ancêtres l’avaient fait.

sw.L: Naye akafanya maovu machoni pa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, sawasawa na yote waliyoyafanya baba zake.
sw.B: Alifanya maovu machoni pa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kama babu zake walivyofanya.
sw.R: Alifanya yale {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliyoyaona kuwa mabaya, kama babu zake walivyofanya.

vi.L: Ông làm điều ác trước mắt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, theo mọi điều tổ phụ ông đã làm.
vi.B: Ông làm điều ác trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, như tổ tiên ông đã làm.
vi.R: Ông làm điều {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} cho là ác, như tổ tiên ông đã làm.

ko.L: 그리고 그는 그의 조상들이 한 모든 일대로 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 눈에 악한 일을 했다.
ko.B: 그는 그의 조상들이 한 그대로 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 보시기에 악한 일을 했다.
ko.R: 그는 그의 조상들처럼 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 악하다고 하신 일을 했다.

pt.L: E fez o mal aos olhos {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, conforme tudo o que os seus pais tinham feito.
pt.B: Ele fez o que era mau aos olhos {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, como os seus antepassados tinham feito.
pt.R: Ele fez o que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} considerava mau, como os seus antepassados tinham feito.

decisions.choice: did the evil in the eyes of Yahweh: the verdict on his reign
decisions.reason: Even in a reign of three months, Kings passes its verdict. After Josiah, each of the last four kings of Judah is judged in the same words (verse 37; 24:9, 19).

decisions.choice: his fathers: the kings before him
decisions.reason: "Fathers" means ancestors, here the kings of Judah who did evil, such as Manasseh and Amon (21:2, 20), not his father Josiah.

decisions.choice: did the evil in [the] eyes of / did what was evil in the sight of / did what the LORD said was evil; ancestors
decisions.reason: The verdict formula is worded the same way at each level in these books. Balanced and Readable say "ancestors" for "fathers".

source.text: וַיַּאַסְרֵהוּ֩ פַרְעֹ֨ה נְכֹ֤ה בְרִבְלָה֙ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ חֲמָ֔ת מִמְּלֹ֖ךְבִּירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וַיִּתֶּן־עֹ֨נֶשׁ֙ עַל־הָאָ֔רֶץ מֵאָ֥ה כִכַּר־כֶּ֖סֶף וְכִכַּ֥ר זָהָֽב׃

records.literal_gloss: And bound him Pharaoh Neco at Riblah in [the] land of Hamath, from reigning in Jerusalem; and he put a fine on the land, a hundred talents of silver and a talent of gold.

en.L: And Pharaoh Neco put him in bonds at Riblah in the land of Hamath, so that [he would] not reign in Jerusalem; and he imposed a fine on the land, 100 talents of silver and a talent of gold.
en.B: Pharaoh Neco put him in chains at Riblah in the land of Hamath, so that he could no longer reign in Jerusalem, and he imposed on the land a payment of {{units:about 7,500 pounds|100 talents}} of silver and {{units:about 75 pounds|a talent}} of gold.
en.R: Pharaoh Neco took Jehoahaz prisoner at Riblah in the land of Hamath, so that he could no longer rule in Jerusalem. Neco forced the land of Judah to pay {{units:about 7,500 pounds|100 talents}} of silver and {{units:about 75 pounds|a talent}} of gold.

es.L: Y el faraón Necao lo encadenó en Ribla, en la tierra de Hamat, para que no reinara en Jerusalén; e impuso a la tierra un tributo de cien talentos de plata y un talento de oro.
es.B: El faraón Necao lo encadenó en Ribla, en la tierra de Hamat, para que ya no reinara en Jerusalén, e impuso a la tierra un pago de {{units:unos 3 400 kilos|cien talentos}} de plata y {{units:unos 34 kilos|un talento}} de oro.
es.R: El faraón Necao tomó preso a Joacaz en Ribla, en la tierra de Hamat, para que ya no gobernara en Jerusalén. Necao obligó al país de Judá a pagar {{units:unos 3 400 kilos|cien talentos}} de plata y {{units:unos 34 kilos|un talento}} de oro.

fr.L: Et le pharaon Néko le mit aux fers à Ribla, au pays de Hamath, pour qu’il ne règne [plus] à Jérusalem ; et il imposa au pays une amende de cent talents d’argent et d’un talent d’or.
fr.B: Le pharaon Néko le fit enchaîner à Ribla, au pays de Hamath, pour qu’il ne règne plus à Jérusalem, et il imposa au pays un tribut de {{units:environ 3,4 tonnes|cent talents}} d’argent et de {{units:environ 34 kilos|un talent}} d’or.
fr.R: Le pharaon Néko a fait prisonnier Joachaz à Ribla, au pays de Hamath, pour qu’il ne puisse plus régner à Jérusalem. Néko a obligé le pays de Juda à payer {{units:environ 3,4 tonnes|cent talents}} d’argent et {{units:environ 34 kilos|un talent}} d’or.

sw.L: Naye Farao Neko akamfunga huko Ribla katika nchi ya Hamathi, ili [asi]tawale huko Yerusalemu; akaitoza nchi faini, talanta 100 za fedha na talanta moja ya dhahabu.
sw.B: Farao Neko alimfunga minyororo huko Ribla katika nchi ya Hamathi, ili asiendelee kutawala huko Yerusalemu, naye akaitoza nchi malipo ya {{units:karibu kilo 3,400|talanta 100}} za fedha na {{units:karibu kilo 34|talanta moja}} ya dhahabu.
sw.R: Farao Neko alimkamata Yehoahazi huko Ribla katika nchi ya Hamathi, ili asiweze tena kutawala huko Yerusalemu. Neko akailazimisha nchi ya Yuda kulipa {{units:karibu kilo 3,400|talanta 100}} za fedha na {{units:karibu kilo 34|talanta moja}} ya dhahabu.

vi.L: Pha-ra-ôn Nê-cô xiềng ông tại Ríp-la trong xứ Ha-mát, để [ông] không trị vì tại Giê-ru-sa-lem nữa; và hắn bắt xứ nộp tiền phạt một trăm ta-lâng bạc và một ta-lâng vàng.
vi.B: Pha-ra-ôn Nê-cô xiềng ông tại Ríp-la trong xứ Ha-mát, để ông không còn trị vì tại Giê-ru-sa-lem nữa, và bắt xứ phải nộp {{units:khoảng 3,4 tấn|một trăm ta-lâng}} bạc và {{units:khoảng 34 kg|một ta-lâng}} vàng.
vi.R: Pha-ra-ôn Nê-cô bắt Giô-a-cha làm tù binh tại Ríp-la trong xứ Ha-mát, để ông không còn cai trị tại Giê-ru-sa-lem nữa. Nê-cô buộc xứ Giu-đa nộp {{units:khoảng 3,4 tấn|một trăm ta-lâng}} bạc và {{units:khoảng 34 kg|một ta-lâng}} vàng.

ko.L: 그리고 바로 느고가 그를 하맛 땅 리블라에 묶어 두어 예루살렘에서 다스리지 못하게 하고, 그 땅에 은 백 달란트와 금 한 달란트의 벌금을 물렸다.
ko.B: 바로 느고는 그를 하맛 땅 리블라에 사슬로 묶어 두어 더는 예루살렘에서 다스리지 못하게 했다. 그리고 그 땅에 은 {{units:약 3.4톤|백 달란트}}에다 금 {{units:약 34킬로그램|한 달란트}}의 벌금을 물렸다.
ko.R: 바로 느고는 하맛 땅 리블라에서 여호아하스를 사로잡아 더는 예루살렘에서 다스리지 못하게 했다. 느고는 유다 땅에 은 {{units:약 3.4톤|백 달란트}}에다 금 {{units:약 34킬로그램|한 달란트}}까지 바치게 했다.

pt.L: E Faraó Neco o prendeu em Ribla, na terra de Hamate, para que não reinasse em Jerusalém; e impôs à terra uma multa de cem talentos de prata e um talento de ouro.
pt.B: Faraó Neco o pôs em correntes em Ribla, na terra de Hamate, para que não reinasse mais em Jerusalém, e impôs à terra o pagamento de {{units:cerca de 3.400 quilos|cem talentos}} de prata e {{units:cerca de 34 quilos|um talento}} de ouro.
pt.R: Faraó Neco prendeu Jeoacaz em Ribla, na terra de Hamate, para que ele não pudesse mais governar em Jerusalém. Neco obrigou a terra de Judá a pagar {{units:cerca de 3.400 quilos|cem talentos}} de prata e {{units:cerca de 34 quilos|um talento}} de ouro.

decisions.choice: so that he would not reign: the reading given in the margin (qere)
decisions.reason: The letters written in the Hebrew text (ketiv) read "when he reigned in Jerusalem"; the reading passed down for reading aloud (qere) is "from reigning", that is, to stop him reigning. The reading aloud is followed. 2 Chronicles 36:3 says that the king of Egypt removed him from the throne in Jerusalem.

decisions.choice: Riblah in the land of Hamath: Neco's base in Syria
decisions.reason: Riblah lay on the Orontes River in Syria, in the region of the city of Hamath. Neco made it his headquarters, as Nebuchadnezzar later did, and it was there that Zedekiah was judged (25:6, 20-21).

decisions.choice: a fine: a payment laid on a conquered land
decisions.reason: The word means a penalty or fine. Here it is the tribute Judah had to pay as a land now under Egypt's control.

decisions.choice: a talent: about 75 pounds of metal
decisions.reason: A talent was the largest weight, about 75 pounds. The sum was smaller than Hezekiah's payment to Assyria, 300 talents of silver and 30 of gold (18:14).

decisions.choice: about 7,500 pounds ... about 75 pounds
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give modern weights, with the talents as the alternative; Literal keeps the talents.

decisions.choice: {{units:unos 3 400 kilos|cien talentos}}; {{units:unos 34 kilos|un talento}}
decisions.reason: The talent at 34 kg, as the terms notes set; Literal keeps the talents, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "environ 3,4 tonnes" / "cent talents"; "environ 34 kilos" / "un talent"
decisions.reason: The talent at 34 kg, as the terms note sets, where the English converts to pounds.

decisions.choice: {{units:karibu kilo 3,400|talanta 100}}; {{units:karibu kilo 34|talanta moja}}
decisions.reason: Metric by default at 34 kg to the talent, with the talents as the alternative; the English gives pounds.

decisions.choice: units spans "약 3.4톤" / "백 달란트" and "약 34킬로그램" / "한 달란트"
decisions.reason: Metric with a talent of 34 kg, as the terms note fixes; joined by "에다" and followed by "의" or "까지" so one particle fits both wordings. Literal keeps the talents.

decisions.choice: {{units:cerca de 3.400 quilos|cem talentos}}; {{units:cerca de 34 quilos|um talento}}
decisions.reason: The units setting gives kilograms by default, where the English gives pounds, at the talent of 34 kg the Old Testament terms use, as 1 Kings does; Literal keeps the talents. "Cem" in words, as round numbers are written. "Ribla" as Numbers 34:11 and "Hamate" as 17:24 in Portuguese.

source.text: וַיַּמְלֵךְ֩ פַּרְעֹ֨ה נְכֹ֜ה אֶת־אֶלְיָקִ֣ים בֶּן־יֹאשִׁיָּ֗הוּ תַּ֚חַת יֹאשִׁיָּ֣הוּ אָבִ֔יו וַיַּסֵּ֥ב אֶת־שְׁמ֖וֹ יְהוֹיָקִ֑ים וְאֶת־יְהוֹאָחָ֣ז לָקָ֔ח וַיָּבֹ֥א מִצְרַ֖יִם וַיָּ֥מָת שָֽׁם׃

records.literal_gloss: And made king Pharaoh Neco Eliakim son of Josiah in place of Josiah his father, and changed his name [to] Jehoiakim; and Jehoahaz he took, and he came [to] Egypt and died there.

en.L: And Pharaoh Neco made Eliakim son of Josiah king in place of Josiah his father, and changed his name [to] Jehoiakim; and Jehoahaz he took away, and he came [to] Egypt and died there.
en.B: Pharaoh Neco made Eliakim son of Josiah king in the place of Josiah his father. He changed Eliakim's name to Jehoiakim. Jehoahaz, though, he took away, and Jehoahaz went to Egypt and died there.
en.R: Pharaoh Neco made Josiah's son Eliakim king in place of his father Josiah. He changed Eliakim's name to Jehoiakim. Neco took Jehoahaz away to Egypt, and Jehoahaz died there.

es.L: Y el faraón Necao puso por rey a Eliaquim hijo de Josías en lugar de Josías su padre, y le cambió el nombre [por] Joacim; y a Joacaz lo tomó, y vino [a] Egipto y murió allí.
es.B: El faraón Necao hizo rey a Eliaquim hijo de Josías en lugar de su padre Josías, y le cambió el nombre por el de Joacim. En cambio, a Joacaz se lo llevó, y Joacaz fue a Egipto y murió allí.
es.R: El faraón Necao hizo rey a Eliaquim, el hijo de Josías, en lugar de su padre Josías. Le cambió el nombre a Eliaquim y le puso Joacim. Necao se llevó a Joacaz a Egipto, y Joacaz murió allí.

fr.L: Et le pharaon Néko fit roi Éliaqim fils de Josias à la place de Josias son père, et il changea son nom [en] Joïaqim ; et Joachaz, il l’emmena, et il vint [en] Égypte et y mourut.
fr.B: Le pharaon Néko établit roi Éliaqim, fils de Josias, à la place de son père Josias, et il changea son nom en Joïaqim. Quant à Joachaz, il l’emmena ; Joachaz alla en Égypte et y mourut.
fr.R: Le pharaon Néko a fait roi Éliaqim, le fils de Josias, à la place de son père Josias. Il a changé le nom d’Éliaqim en Joïaqim. Néko a emmené Joachaz en Égypte, et Joachaz y est mort.

sw.L: Naye Farao Neko akamtawaza Eliakimu mwana wa Yosia kuwa mfalme mahali pa Yosia baba yake, akabadilisha jina lake [kuwa] Yehoyakimu; naye Yehoahazi akamchukua, naye akaja [hata] Misri, akafa huko.
sw.B: Farao Neko alimtawaza Eliakimu mwana wa Yosia kuwa mfalme mahali pa Yosia baba yake. Akabadilisha jina la Eliakimu kuwa Yehoyakimu. Lakini Yehoahazi akamchukua, naye Yehoahazi akaenda Misri, akafa huko.
sw.R: Farao Neko alimfanya Eliakimu, mwana wa Yosia, kuwa mfalme mahali pa baba yake Yosia. Akabadilisha jina la Eliakimu kuwa Yehoyakimu. Neko akamchukua Yehoahazi mpaka Misri, naye Yehoahazi akafa huko.

vi.L: Pha-ra-ôn Nê-cô lập Ê-li-a-kim con trai Giô-si-a làm vua thay Giô-si-a cha ông, và đổi tên ông [thành] Giê-hô-gia-kim; còn Giô-a-cha, hắn bắt đi, và ông đến Ai Cập và chết tại đó.
vi.B: Pha-ra-ôn Nê-cô lập Ê-li-a-kim con trai Giô-si-a làm vua thay Giô-si-a cha ông, và đổi tên Ê-li-a-kim thành Giê-hô-gia-kim. Còn Giô-a-cha thì hắn bắt đi; Giô-a-cha bị đưa sang Ai Cập và chết tại đó.
vi.R: Pha-ra-ôn Nê-cô lập Ê-li-a-kim con trai Giô-si-a làm vua thay cha là Giô-si-a. Hắn đổi tên Ê-li-a-kim thành Giê-hô-gia-kim. Nê-cô bắt Giô-a-cha đem sang Ai Cập, và Giô-a-cha chết tại đó.

ko.L: 그리고 바로 느고가 요시야의 아들 엘리아김을 그의 아버지 요시야를 대신하여 왕으로 삼고, 그의 이름을 여호야김으로 바꾸었다. 그리고 여호아하스는 그가 데려갔는데, 그는 이집트로 가서 거기에서 죽었다.
ko.B: 바로 느고는 요시야의 아들 엘리아김을 그의 아버지 요시야의 뒤를 이어 왕으로 세우고, 그의 이름을 여호야김으로 바꾸었다. 그러나 여호아하스는 데려갔고, 여호아하스는 이집트로 가서 거기에서 죽었다.
ko.R: 바로 느고는 요시야의 아들 엘리아김을 그의 아버지 요시야의 뒤를 이어 왕으로 세웠다. 그는 엘리아김의 이름을 여호야김으로 바꾸었다. 느고는 여호아하스를 이집트로 끌고 갔고, 여호아하스는 거기에서 죽었다.

pt.L: E Faraó Neco fez Eliaquim, filho de Josias, rei em lugar de Josias, seu pai, e mudou o seu nome [para] Jeoaquim; e Jeoacaz ele levou, e ele veio [ao] Egito e morreu ali.
pt.B: Faraó Neco fez Eliaquim, filho de Josias, rei no lugar de Josias, seu pai, e mudou o nome de Eliaquim para Jeoaquim. Mas a Jeoacaz ele levou embora, e Jeoacaz foi para o Egito e morreu ali.
pt.R: Faraó Neco fez Eliaquim, filho de Josias, rei no lugar do seu pai, Josias. Ele mudou o nome de Eliaquim para Jeoaquim. Neco levou Jeoacaz para o Egito, e Jeoacaz morreu ali.

decisions.choice: changed his name: a sign of Egypt's power over the king
decisions.reason: An overlord who gave a king a new name showed that the king ruled by his will. Nebuchadnezzar later did the same, changing Mattaniah's name to Zedekiah (24:17).

decisions.choice: Eliakim, Jehoiakim: "God raises up" and "Yahweh raises up"
decisions.reason: The two names mean almost the same. The new one replaces the general word for God with the name of Yahweh, the God of Judah. Neco did not give him the name of an Egyptian god.

decisions.choice: he came to Egypt and died there: Jehoahaz
decisions.reason: The subject of "came" and "died" is Jehoahaz. Jeremiah 22:10-12 says of Shallum, that is Jehoahaz, that he would never return but would die in the place where he was taken captive.

decisions.choice: in place of Josiah his father: as if Jehoahaz had not reigned
decisions.reason: Neco set Eliakim in Josiah's place, passing over the three months of Jehoahaz, whom the people of the land had chosen (verse 30).

decisions.choice: Jehoahaz went to Egypt and died there
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name Jehoahaz as the one who died, following m3. Literal keeps the Hebrew "he".

decisions.choice: "Joacim"
decisions.reason: "Joacim" as the terms note's table gives Jehoiakim, kept apart from "Joacaz" (Jehoahaz) and "Joaquín" (Jehoiachin).

decisions.choice: Joïaqim
decisions.reason: The form of the terms note.

decisions.choice: Eliaquim; Jeoaquim
decisions.reason: For the whole book: "Jeoaquim" (m2) is the form the shared list for Kings sets for Josiah's son, kept apart from his son "Joaquim" (24:6), as the Hebrew names differ; "Eliaquim" is the usual Brazilian form of his first name.

source.text: וְהַכֶּ֣סֶף וְהַזָּהָ֗ב נָתַ֤ן יְהוֹיָקִים֙ לְפַרְעֹ֔ה אַ֚ךְ הֶעֱרִ֣יךְ אֶת־הָאָ֔רֶץ לָתֵ֥ת אֶת־הַכֶּ֖סֶף עַל־פִּ֣י פַרְעֹ֑ה אִ֣ישׁ כְּעֶרְכּ֗וֹ נָגַ֞שׂ אֶת־הַכֶּ֤סֶף וְאֶת־הַזָּהָב֙ אֶת־עַ֣ם הָאָ֔רֶץ לָתֵ֖ת לְפַרְעֹ֥ה נְכֹֽה׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And the silver and the gold gave Jehoiakim to Pharaoh; only he assessed the land to give the silver by [the] mouth of Pharaoh; each according to his assessment he exacted the silver and the gold from [the] people of the land, to give to Pharaoh Neco.

en.L: And the silver and the gold Jehoiakim gave to Pharaoh; but he assessed the land to give the silver at the command of Pharaoh; each according to his assessment, he exacted the silver and the gold from the people of the land, to give to Pharaoh Neco.
en.B: Jehoiakim paid Pharaoh the silver and the gold, but to raise the money Pharaoh demanded he had to tax the land. He exacted the silver and gold from the people of the land, each paying the amount assessed, to give to Pharaoh Neco.
en.R: Jehoiakim paid Pharaoh the silver and gold he demanded. To do this, he taxed the land. He made the people of the land pay silver and gold, each person according to what they owned, and he gave it to Pharaoh Neco.

es.L: Y la plata y el oro los dio Joacim al faraón; pero tasó la tierra para dar el dinero conforme a la orden del faraón; a cada uno según su tasación exigió la plata y el oro del pueblo de la tierra, para dárselo al faraón Necao.
es.B: Joacim le pagó al faraón la plata y el oro, pero para reunir el dinero que el faraón exigía tuvo que poner impuestos a la tierra. Exigió la plata y el oro al pueblo de la tierra, a cada uno según lo que se le había fijado, para dárselo al faraón Necao.
es.R: Joacim le pagó al faraón la plata y el oro que le exigía. Para hacerlo, puso impuestos al país. Obligó al pueblo de la tierra a pagar plata y oro, a cada uno según lo que tenía, y se lo dio al faraón Necao.

fr.L: Et l’argent et l’or, Joïaqim les donna au pharaon ; mais il taxa le pays pour donner l’argent selon l’ordre du pharaon ; chacun selon sa taxe, il exigea l’argent et l’or du peuple du pays, pour [les] donner au pharaon Néko.
fr.B: Joïaqim versa au pharaon l’argent et l’or, mais pour réunir la somme exigée par le pharaon, il dut imposer le pays. Il exigea l’argent et l’or du peuple du pays, chacun selon la taxe fixée, pour les donner au pharaon Néko.
fr.R: Joïaqim a payé au pharaon l’argent et l’or qu’il demandait. Pour cela, il a fait payer un impôt au pays. Il a obligé le peuple du pays à donner de l’argent et de l’or, chacun selon ce qu’il possédait, et il l’a donné au pharaon Néko.

sw.L: Na fedha na dhahabu Yehoyakimu akampa Farao; lakini akaitoza nchi kodi ili kutoa fedha kwa amri ya Farao; kila mtu kwa kadiri ya kodi yake, alidai fedha na dhahabu kutoka kwa watu wa nchi, ili kumpa Farao Neko.
sw.B: Yehoyakimu alimlipa Farao fedha na dhahabu, lakini ili kupata fedha ambayo Farao alidai, alilazimika kuitoza nchi kodi. Alidai fedha na dhahabu kutoka kwa watu wa nchi, kila mmoja kwa kadiri aliyotozwa, ili kumpa Farao Neko.
sw.R: Yehoyakimu alimlipa Farao fedha na dhahabu aliyodai. Ili kufanya hivyo, aliwatoza watu wa nchi kodi. Aliwalazimisha watu wa nchi walipe fedha na dhahabu, kila mtu kwa kadiri ya mali aliyokuwa nayo, naye akampa Farao Neko.

vi.L: Bạc và vàng, Giê-hô-gia-kim nộp cho Pha-ra-ôn; nhưng ông đánh thuế xứ để nộp bạc theo lệnh Pha-ra-ôn; ông thu bạc và vàng từ dân trong xứ, mỗi người theo mức đã định, để nộp cho Pha-ra-ôn Nê-cô.
vi.B: Giê-hô-gia-kim nộp bạc và vàng cho Pha-ra-ôn, nhưng để có số bạc Pha-ra-ôn đòi, ông phải đánh thuế xứ. Ông thu bạc vàng của dân trong xứ, mỗi người nộp theo mức đã định, để nộp cho Pha-ra-ôn Nê-cô.
vi.R: Giê-hô-gia-kim nộp cho Pha-ra-ôn số bạc vàng hắn đòi. Để làm việc ấy, ông đánh thuế cả xứ. Ông bắt dân trong xứ nộp bạc vàng, mỗi người tùy theo của cải mình có, rồi ông nộp cho Pha-ra-ôn Nê-cô.

ko.L: 그리고 여호야김이 그 은과 금을 바로에게 주었다. 다만 그는 바로의 명령대로 그 은을 바치려고 그 땅에 세금을 매겼다. 그는 그 땅의 백성에게서 각 사람의 평가에 따라 은과 금을 거두어 바로 느고에게 주었다.
ko.B: 여호야김은 바로에게 은과 금을 바쳤다. 그러나 바로가 요구한 돈을 마련하려고 그는 그 땅에 세금을 매겨야 했다. 그는 그 땅의 백성에게서 각자 매겨진 대로 은과 금을 강제로 거두어 바로 느고에게 바쳤다.
ko.R: 여호야김은 바로가 요구한 은과 금을 바쳤다. 그러려고 그는 백성에게 세금을 매겼다. 그는 그 땅의 백성에게 각자 가진 재산에 따라 은과 금을 억지로 내게 하여 바로 느고에게 바쳤다.

pt.L: E a prata e o ouro Jeoaquim deu a Faraó; porém avaliou a terra para dar a prata por ordem de Faraó; cada um conforme a sua avaliação, exigiu a prata e o ouro do povo da terra, para dar a Faraó Neco.
