pt.B: Jeoaquim pagou a Faraó a prata e o ouro, mas, para levantar o dinheiro que Faraó exigiu, teve de cobrar impostos da terra. Ele exigiu do povo da terra a prata e o ouro, cada um conforme o valor estabelecido, para dar a Faraó Neco.
pt.R: Jeoaquim pagou a Faraó a prata e o ouro que ele exigiu. Para isso, ele cobrou impostos da terra. Obrigou o povo da terra a pagar prata e ouro, cada pessoa conforme o que possuía, e deu tudo a Faraó Neco.

decisions.choice: assessed: set a value on what each owned
decisions.reason: The verb means to set a value, as a priest set the value of a vow (Leviticus 27:8, 12). Jehoiakim had each man's wealth valued and taxed by it. Menahem of Israel had raised Assyria's tribute in a similar way (15:20).

decisions.choice: exacted: forced payment, as an oppressor
decisions.reason: The verb is used of taskmasters driving people to work (Exodus 5:6) and of creditors pressing for payment (Deuteronomy 15:2).

decisions.choice: by the mouth of Pharaoh: at Pharaoh's command
decisions.reason: The "mouth" of a ruler is his spoken order.

decisions.choice: the people of the land: those who had made Jehoahaz king
decisions.reason: The same people of the land who had chosen Jehoahaz (verse 30) now bore the cost of Egypt's rule.

decisions.choice: according to what they owned
decisions.reason: Readable says what the assessment was based on (m1).

decisions.choice: avaliou (L), cobrar impostos (B, R); exigiu (L, B), obrigou ... a pagar (R); por ordem de Faraó (L)
decisions.reason: "Avaliar" is the word Leviticus 27:8 uses in Portuguese for setting a value (m1); "exigir" says the forced payment (m2). Literal says "por ordem" for "by the mouth" (m3), as the English Literal says "at the command". "Faraó" without the article, as a title used as a name, as the English has it.

source.text: בֶּן־עֶשְׂרִ֨ים וְחָמֵ֤שׁ שָׁנָ֨ה יְהוֹיָקִ֣ים בְּמָלְכ֔וֹ וְאַחַ֤ת עֶשְׂרֵה֙ שָׁנָ֔ה מָלַ֖ךְ בִּירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְשֵׁ֣ם אִמּ֔וֹ זְבוּדָּ֥ה בַת־פְּדָיָ֖ה מִן־רוּמָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: [A] son of twenty and five year[s] [was] Jehoiakim when he became king, and eleven year[s] he reigned in Jerusalem; and [the] name of his mother [was] Zebudah daughter of Pedaiah from Rumah.

en.L: A son of twenty-five years [was] Jehoiakim when he became king, and eleven years he reigned in Jerusalem; and the name of his mother [was] Zebudah daughter of Pedaiah from Rumah.
en.B: Jehoiakim was twenty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem. His mother's name was Zebudah daughter of Pedaiah from Rumah.
en.R: Jehoiakim was twenty-five years old when he became king. He ruled in Jerusalem for eleven years. His mother was Zebudah, the daughter of Pedaiah from Rumah.

es.L: Hijo de veinticinco años [era] Joacim cuando comenzó a reinar, y once años reinó en Jerusalén; y el nombre de su madre [era] Zebuda hija de Pedaías, de Ruma.
es.B: Joacim tenía veinticinco años cuando comenzó a reinar, y reinó once años en Jerusalén. Su madre se llamaba Zebuda hija de Pedaías, de Ruma.
es.R: Joacim tenía veinticinco años cuando llegó a ser rey. Gobernó en Jerusalén durante once años. Su madre se llamaba Zebuda y era hija de Pedaías, de Ruma.

fr.L: Joïaqim avait vingt-cinq ans quand il devint roi, et il régna onze ans à Jérusalem ; et le nom de sa mère [était] Zebouda fille de Pedaya, de Rouma.
fr.B: Joïaqim avait vingt-cinq ans quand il devint roi, et il régna onze ans à Jérusalem. Sa mère s’appelait Zebouda, fille de Pedaya, de Rouma.
fr.R: Joïaqim avait vingt-cinq ans quand il est devenu roi, et il a régné à Jérusalem pendant onze ans. Sa mère s’appelait Zebouda ; c’était la fille de Pedaya, de Rouma.

sw.L: Yehoyakimu [alikuwa] mwana wa miaka ishirini na mitano alipoanza kutawala, na miaka kumi na mmoja alitawala huko Yerusalemu; na jina la mama yake [lilikuwa] Zebuda binti Pedaya wa Ruma.
sw.B: Yehoyakimu alikuwa na umri wa miaka ishirini na mitano alipoanza kutawala, naye akatawala miaka kumi na mmoja huko Yerusalemu. Mama yake aliitwa Zebuda binti Pedaya wa Ruma.
sw.R: Yehoyakimu alikuwa na umri wa miaka ishirini na mitano alipoanza kutawala. Alitawala huko Yerusalemu kwa miaka kumi na mmoja. Mama yake aliitwa Zebuda binti Pedaya wa Ruma.

vi.L: Giê-hô-gia-kim [được] hai mươi lăm tuổi khi lên làm vua, và trị vì mười một năm tại Giê-ru-sa-lem. Tên mẹ ông [là] Xê-bu-đa con gái Phê-đa-gia, người Ru-ma.
vi.B: Giê-hô-gia-kim được hai mươi lăm tuổi khi lên làm vua và trị vì mười một năm tại Giê-ru-sa-lem. Mẹ vua tên là Xê-bu-đa con gái Phê-đa-gia, người Ru-ma.
vi.R: Giê-hô-gia-kim được hai mươi lăm tuổi khi lên làm vua. Ông cai trị tại Giê-ru-sa-lem mười một năm. Mẹ vua tên là Xê-bu-đa, con gái Phê-đa-gia, người Ru-ma.

ko.L: 여호야김이 왕이 되었을 때 이십오 세[였고], 예루살렘에서 십일 년 동안 다스렸다. 그리고 그의 어머니의 이름은 루마 출신 브다야의 딸 스비다였다.
ko.B: 여호야김은 이십오 세에 왕이 되어 예루살렘에서 십일 년 동안 다스렸다. 그의 어머니의 이름은 루마 출신 브다야의 딸 스비다였다.
ko.R: 여호야김은 스물다섯 살에 왕이 되었다. 그는 예루살렘에서 십일 년 동안 다스렸다. 그의 어머니는 루마 출신 브다야의 딸 스비다였다.

pt.L: Jeoaquim [tinha] vinte e cinco anos quando começou a reinar, e onze anos reinou em Jerusalém; e o nome da sua mãe [era] Zebuda, filha de Pedaías, de Rumá.
pt.B: Jeoaquim tinha vinte e cinco anos quando começou a reinar, e reinou onze anos em Jerusalém. A sua mãe se chamava Zebuda, filha de Pedaías, de Rumá.
pt.R: Jeoaquim tinha vinte e cinco anos quando se tornou rei. Ele governou em Jerusalém durante onze anos. A mãe dele era Zebuda, filha de Pedaías, de Rumá.

decisions.choice: Zebudah: the reading given in the margin (qere)
decisions.reason: The letters written in the Hebrew text (ketiv) give the name as Zebidah; the reading passed down for reading aloud (qere) is Zebudah. The reading aloud is followed.

decisions.choice: twenty-five years old: older than Jehoahaz
decisions.reason: Jehoiakim was two years older than Jehoahaz (verse 31), yet the people of the land had passed him over. His mother was a different wife of Josiah. His reign, about 609 to 598 BC, goes on into chapter 24.

decisions.choice: Rumah: a town not certainly known
decisions.reason: Rumah is not named elsewhere in the Old Testament. It may be a place in Galilee, which would mean Josiah married into a family from the old northern kingdom.

decisions.choice: Jehoiakim was twenty-five years old when he became king
decisions.reason: As in verse 31.

source.text: וַיַּ֥עַשׂ הָרַ֖ע בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה כְּכֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־עָשׂ֖וּ אֲבֹתָֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: And he did the evil in [the] eyes of Yahweh, according to all that had done his fathers.

en.L: And he did the evil in [the] eyes of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, according to all that his fathers had done.
en.B: He did what was evil in the sight of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, just as his ancestors had done.
en.R: He did what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} said was evil, just as his ancestors had done.

es.L: E hizo lo malo a los ojos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, conforme a todo lo que habían hecho sus padres.
es.B: Hizo lo malo a los ojos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, tal como lo habían hecho sus antepasados.
es.R: Hizo lo que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} reprueba, tal como lo habían hecho sus antepasados.

fr.L: Et il fit ce qui est mal aux yeux {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, selon tout ce qu’avaient fait ses pères.
fr.B: Il fit ce qui est mal aux yeux {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, tout comme ses ancêtres.
fr.R: Il a fait ce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} déclare mauvais, comme ses ancêtres l’avaient fait.

sw.L: Naye akafanya maovu machoni pa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, sawasawa na yote waliyoyafanya baba zake.
sw.B: Alifanya maovu machoni pa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kama babu zake walivyofanya.
sw.R: Alifanya yale {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliyoyaona kuwa mabaya, kama babu zake walivyofanya.

vi.L: Ông làm điều ác trước mắt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, theo mọi điều tổ phụ ông đã làm.
vi.B: Ông làm điều ác trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, như tổ tiên ông đã làm.
vi.R: Ông làm điều {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} cho là ác, như tổ tiên ông đã làm.

ko.L: 그리고 그는 그의 조상들이 한 모든 일대로 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 눈에 악한 일을 했다.
ko.B: 그는 그의 조상들이 한 그대로 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 보시기에 악한 일을 했다.
ko.R: 그는 그의 조상들처럼 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 악하다고 하신 일을 했다.

pt.L: E fez o mal aos olhos {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, conforme tudo o que os seus pais tinham feito.
pt.B: Ele fez o que era mau aos olhos {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, como os seus antepassados tinham feito.
pt.R: Ele fez o que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} considerava mau, como os seus antepassados tinham feito.

decisions.choice: did the evil in the eyes of Yahweh: the verdict on Jehoiakim
decisions.reason: The same verdict as on his brother (verse 32). Jeremiah tells of his reign: he burned the scroll of Jeremiah's prophecies (Jeremiah 36:23) and built his palace with unpaid labor (Jeremiah 22:13-19).

decisions.choice: the verdict formula; ancestors
decisions.reason: As in verse 32.
